import { Ctx, On, Start, Update } from "nestjs-telegraf";
import { PrismaService } from "src/core/prisma/prisma.service";
import { Context } from "telegraf";
import { UserService } from "./user.service";
import { editMessage, getEditButtons, homeEntity, response, sendContactEntity, targetsEdit, updateTarget } from "./entitiys";

@Update()
export class RegisterService {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly userService: UserService
  ) { }

  @Start()
  async start(@Ctx() ctx: Context) {
    ctx.reply(`Contactingizni yuboring`, sendContactEntity)
  }

  @On("contact")
  async getContact(@Ctx() ctx: Context) {

    await this.userService.createUser(ctx)
  }

  @On("text")
  async home(@Ctx() ctx: Context) {
    const text = ctx.message?.['text'].trim()
    const id = ctx.from?.id
    const step = await this.userService.getStep(id)
    if (!text || text.length === 0) {
      return
    }
    if (text.startsWith("Profi")) {
      await this.sendProfile(ctx)
      return
    }
    if (text.startsWith("Edi")) {
      if (!(await this.userService.findByUserId(id))) {
        ctx.reply("Ro'yxatdan o'tmagan foydalnuvchi !", sendContactEntity)
        return
      }
      ctx.reply(editMessage, getEditButtons)
      return
    }
    if(text === 'Delete'){
      await this.userService.delete(id)
      ctx.reply("/start",sendContactEntity)
      return
    }
    if(text === "Clear"){
      
    }
    if (text.startsWith("4 Home")) {
      if (!(await this.userService.findByUserId(id))) {
        ctx.reply("Ro'yxatdan o'tmagan foydalnuvchi !", sendContactEntity)
        return
      }
      ctx.reply("Menyudan tanlang !", homeEntity)
    } else {
      if (targetsEdit.includes(text)) this.editProfile(ctx, text, id)
      if (step === 0) return
      await this.updateItem(ctx, text, id)
      this.sendProfile(ctx)
      return
    }
  }

  async sendProfile(ctx: Context) {
    const id = ctx.message?.from.id
    // @ts-ignore
    const data = await this.userService.findByUserId(id)
    if (!data) {
      ctx.reply("Ma'lumotlar  topilmadi", sendContactEntity)
      return
    }
    ctx.reply(response(data))
  }

  async editProfile(ctx: Context, text: string, id: number | undefined) {
    const user = (await this.userService.findByUserId(id))
    if (!user) {
      ctx.reply("Ro'yxatdan o'tmagan foydalnuvchi !", sendContactEntity)
      return
    }
    if (text.startsWith("1 Ism")) {
      this.editStep(ctx, 1)
      ctx.reply("Ismingizni kiriting !", homeEntity)
    }
    if (text.startsWith("2 Fam")) {
      await this.editStep(ctx, 2)
      ctx.reply("Familiyangizni kiriting !", homeEntity)
    }
    if (text.startsWith("3 Tug")) {
      await this.editStep(ctx, 3)
      ctx.reply("Tug'gilgan sanangizni kiriting !", homeEntity)
    }
  }

  async editStep(ctx: Context, step: number) {
    const id = ctx.message?.from.id
    // @ts-ignore
    const result = await this.userService.updateUser(id, { step })
    if (!result) {
      return
    }
  }

  async updateItem(ctx: Context, text: string, id: number | undefined) {
    const user = (await this.userService.findByUserId(id))
    console.log(user)
    if (!user) {
      ctx.reply("Ro'yxatdan o'tmagan foydalnuvchi !", sendContactEntity)
      return
    }
    // @ts-ignore1
    const step = await this.userService.getStep(id)
    // @ts-ignore
    const data = updateTarget(ctx, text, step)
    if (data === "invalid") return
    console.log(data)
    // @ts-ignore
    await this.userService.updateUser(id, data)
    this.editStep(ctx, 0)

  }

}

Clear qilish kerak message.from.id  ga tegishli chatni clear qilish

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Agar siz `Clear` komandasi yuborilganda foydalanuvchiga tegishli barcha chatni (yoki ma’lumotlarini) tozalamoqchi bo‘lsangiz, bu bir necha maqsadga xizmat qilishi mumkin. Masalan:

1. **Userning ma’lumotlarini o‘chirish**
2. **Botning oldingi yuborgan xabarlarini o‘chirish (Telegram chat tarixini tozalash emas, bot yuborganlarini o‘chirish)**

Telegram API orqali **foydalanuvchining Telegram chat tarixini butunlay o‘chirishning iloji yo‘q** (faqat foydalanuvchi o‘zi o‘chirishi mumkin). Ammo siz quyidagilarni qilishingiz mumkin:

---

### 1. Agar siz userga tegishli ma’lumotlarni `Clear` orqali o‘chirib tashlamoqchi bo‘lsangiz:

`UserService` ichida biror `clear` metodi yozing:

```ts
// user.service.ts
async clearUserData(userId: number) {
  return this.prisma.user.update({
    where: { userId },
    data: {
      firstName: null,
      lastName: null,
      birthDate: null,
      step: 0,
    },
  });
}
```

So'ngra `RegisterService` ichidagi `Clear` holatiga shu kodni qo‘shing:

```ts
if(text === "Clear"){
  await this.userService.clearUserData(id)
  ctx.reply("Ma'lumotlaringiz tozalandi. Qayta boshlash uchun /start buyrug'ini bering.")
  return
}
```

---

### 2. Agar siz bot yuborgan eski xabarlarni o‘chirmoqchi bo‘lsangiz:

Siz faqatgina **bot o‘zi yuborgan xabarlarni** va faqat **xabar ID sizda saqlangan bo‘lsa** o‘chira olasiz:

```ts
await ctx.deleteMessage(messageId)
```

Agar siz xabarlarni real vaqtda saqlamagan bo‘lsangiz, ularni qayta topish qiyin bo‘ladi. Ammo agar siz `ctx.reply(...)` qilganingizda xabarni saqlab qo‘ysangiz, keyinchalik o‘chirishingiz mumkin.

---

### Yakuniy Tavsiya

Agar siz faqat foydalanuvchining bazadagi ma’lumotlarini tozalashni xohlasangiz, bu eng oson yo‘l:

```ts
if(text === "Clear"){
  await this.userService.clearUserData(id)
  ctx.reply("Ma'lumotlaringiz tozalandi. /start orqali qayta boshlang.")
  return
}
```

Agar sizga xabarlarni ham o‘chirish kerak bo‘lsa, ulardan `message_id` ni saqlab borishingiz kerak bo‘ladi.

Aytmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, bu xabar ID’larni qanday saqlash yoki boshqarish haqida ham yordam bera olaman.

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

await ctx.deleteMessage(messageId)

user yuborgan messagelarni tozalash keraka

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Telegram API orqali **foydalanuvchi tomonidan yuborilgan xabarlarni o‘chirish** uchun quyidagilar muhim:

---

### 🚫 Cheklov: Bot **foydalanuvchi yuborgan xabarlarni o‘chira olmaydi**, **agar**:
- Bot **supergroup yoki private chatda admin emas** bo‘lsa (faqat guruh uchun).
- Yoki **private chatda bo‘lsa**, bot **foydalanuvchi yuborgan xabarni** umuman **o‘chira olmaydi**. Telegram **private chatda foydalanuvchi yuborgan xabarni faqat foydalanuvchi o‘zi o‘chira oladi**.

---

### ✅ Qayerda o‘chirish mumkin:
1. **Supergroup chatda**: bot `can_delete_messages` huquqiga ega bo‘lsa, foydalanuvchi yuborgan xabarni o‘chira oladi.
2. **Private chatda**: **faqat bot yuborgan xabarni** o‘chira oladi.

---

### 📌 Xulosa:
Agar sizning botingiz **private chatda ishlayotgan bo‘lsa (ya’ni user bilan 1:1)**:
- Siz `ctx.message.message_id` orqali **user yuborgan matnni aniqlasangiz ham**, uni o‘chira olmaysiz.
- `ctx.deleteMessage()` faqat bot yuborgan xabarni o‘chiradi.

---

### 🔄 Alternativ Yechim:
Agar maqsad "chatni tozalash" effekti berish bo‘lsa, quyidagi usulni ko‘rib chiqing:

#### 1. Botning o‘z yuborgan xabarlarini saqlang va o‘chiring:
```ts
const sent = await ctx.reply("Ma'lumotlaringiz tozalandi.")
setTimeout(() => {
  ctx.deleteMessage(sent.message_id) // botning o‘zi yuborgan xabarni o‘chirish
}, 5000)
```

#### 2. Foydalanuvchiga “chatni o‘chiring” deb ayting:
```ts
ctx.reply("Iltimos, chatni tozalash uchun Telegram ilovasida o‘zingiz xabarlarni o‘chiring.")
```

---

Agar siz guruh yoki supergroupda ishlayotgan bo‘lsangiz, va bot admin bo‘lsa, quyidagicha o‘chirishingiz mumkin:

```ts
const messageId = ctx.message.message_id;
await ctx.deleteMessage(messageId); // Foydalanuvchi yuborgan xabarni o‘chiradi (faqat guruhda)
```

---

Aytgancha, agar siz `Clear` komandasi uchun ham foydalanuvchi yuborgan **oxirgi bir nechta xabarni** o‘chirmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, bu uchun **xabar ID-larni to‘plab saqlashingiz** kerak (masalan, Redis yoki vaqtinchalik massivda). Shunda `Clear` komandasi bosilganda, o‘sha ID’lar bo‘yicha o‘chirasiz.

Xohlasangiz, shunaqa xabarlarni saqlab, keyinchalik tozalovchi yechim tuzishda yordam bera olaman.

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

Guruhda emas user bilan boot yozishmalarining tarixini tozalash kerak

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Afsuski, **Telegram’ning rasmiy cheklovlari**ga ko‘ra, **bot Telegram’ning “private chat” (ya'ni foydalanuvchi bilan 1:1 suhbat) tarixidagi foydalanuvchi yuborgan xabarlarni o‘chira olmaydi**.

### ❌ Nima qilishning iloji yo‘q:

- Siz **foydalanuvchi yuborgan xabarlarni** `ctx.deleteMessage(messageId)` bilan **o‘chira olmaysiz**.
- Telegram’ning `deleteMessage` metodi faqat **bot o‘zi yuborgan xabarlarni o‘chira oladi** (va u ham faqat 48 soat ichida).

---

### ✅ Siz qilishingiz mumkin bo‘lgan narsalar:

#### 1. **Bot yuborgan xabarlarni o‘chirish** (agar siz ularning `message_id` sini saqlasangiz):

```ts
const sent = await ctx.reply("Bu xabar 5 soniyada o'chiriladi");
setTimeout(() => {
  ctx.deleteMessage(sent.message_id);
}, 5000);
```

> Agar siz barcha yuborilgan xabarlarni saqlab boradigan bo‘lsangiz (masalan, massivda yoki DB’da), keyinchalik ularni tozalashingiz mumkin.

#### 2. **Userga chatni o‘zi tozalashini so‘rash**:

```ts
await ctx.reply("Telegram chat tarixini tozalash uchun xabarlarni o‘zingiz o‘chirishingiz kerak.");
```

Yoki yanada foydalanuvchiga qulayroq tushuntirish:

```ts
await ctx.reply("Telegram cheklovlariga ko‘ra, siz yuborgan xabarlarni faqat o‘zingiz o‘chira olasiz. Chat tarixini o‘chirish uchun xabarlaringizni qo‘lda o‘chirishingiz kerak.");
```

---

### 🛡 Xulosa

Telegram'da foydalanuvchi bilan bot o‘rtasidagi **private chat tarixini avtomatik tozalash** imkoniyati mavjud **emas**. Bu Telegram’ning xavfsizlik siyosati bilan bog‘liq.

Agar siz istasangiz, foydalanuvchining xabarlarini ko‘rsatilmasligi yoki bot faqat vaqtincha xabar yuborib, o‘zi o‘chirib yuborishi uchun **ephemeral chat effektini** tuzishda yordam bera olaman.

Shunaqa tizim kerakmi (masalan: 5 soniyadan keyin har bir bot xabari o‘chib ketsin)?

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

requiere_contact  cabi telegramning clear history ni ishga tushurish mumkinmi

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Yo‘q, hozirgi vaqtda **Telegram Bot API** orqali **`require_contact`** yoki boshqa hech qanday parametr orqali **foydalanuvchi bilan bot o‘rtasidagi chat tarixini tozalash (clear history)** **imkoniyati mavjud emas**.

---

### 🔍 Keling, qisqacha tushunamiz:

#### ❓ `request_contact` yoki `require_contact` nima?

`request_contact: true` — bu `<KeyboardButton>` parametri bo‘lib, foydalanuvchidan kontaktini yuborishni so‘rash uchun ishlatiladi.

Misol:

```ts
reply("Kontakt yuboring", {
  reply_markup: {
    keyboard: [[{ text: "Kontaktni yuborish", request_contact: true }]],
    resize_keyboard: true,
    one_time_keyboard: true
  }
})
```

Bu **keyboardni yuboradi**, foydalanuvchi kontaktni yuboradi — **xolos**. Bu hech qachon tarixni tozalamaydi.

---

### ❌ Telegram’da "clear history"ni boshlatib yuborish imkoniyati:

- **Telegram’ning “Clear History” funksiyasi** — faqat foydalanuvchi tomonidan qo‘lda bajariladi.
- Bot orqali **chatni tozalash, chatni butunlay o‘chirish, yoki “auto-delete”ni ishga tushirish** imkoniyati mavjud emas.
- Faqat guruhlarda, agar bot admin bo‘lsa, u ba’zi xabarlarni o‘chirishi mumkin.

---

### ✅ Alternativ yo‘llar:

Agar siz foydalanuvchiga “chatni tozalashni tavsiya qilish”ni xohlasangiz, siz quyidagicha prompt berishingiz mumkin:

```ts
await ctx.reply(
  "Agar chat tarixini tozalamoqchi bo‘lsangiz, Telegram ilovasida chatni oching, yuqoridagi menyudan 'Clear Chat History' tugmasini tanlang."
);
```

---

### 🤔 Nima qilish mumkin?

Agar siz foydalanuvchiga:

- Faqat vaqtinchalik (ephemeral) xabar yuborishni istasangiz
- Har bir bot xabari 5–10 soniyadan so‘ng o‘chib ketishini istasangiz

…shunday tizimni yozish mumkin. Masalan:

```ts
const msg = await ctx.reply("Bu xabar 5 soniyadan so‘ng o‘chadi.");
setTimeout(() => {
  ctx.deleteMessage(msg.message_id);
}, 5000);
```

---

Agar sizga shunaqa “xabarlar o‘z-o‘zidan o‘chadigan” botni tuzishga yordam kerak bo‘lsa, to‘liq misol beraman. Shu turdagi xususiyat kerakmi?

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

Men requere contact ga o'xshash clear chat keynoard so'rash mumkinmi

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Yo‘q, **`request_contact`** kabi **“clear chat”** funksiyasini **klaviatura tugmasi orqali chaqirib bo‘lmaydi**. Telegram **Bot API** quyidagi cheklovlarga ega:

---

### ❌ Nima *mumkin emas*:

- Siz **"Clear chat history"** (yoki “Delete chat”) funksiyasini **hech qanday tugma bilan avtomatik yoki majburan foydalanuvchiga ishga tushirib bera olmaysiz**.
- Telegram **foydalanuvchi xavfsizligi** va **ma’lumotni nazorat qilish** tamoyillari sababli, bu funksiyalar **faqat foydalanuvchining o‘z ixtiyori bilan Telegram ilovasida** bajarilishi kerak.

---

### ✅ Nima *mumkin*:

Siz **klaviatura tugmasi** orqali foydalanuvchiga *tavsiyanoma* (prompt) sifatida biror **yo‘riqnoma** yuborishingiz mumkin.

#### Misol:
```ts
await ctx.reply("Chat tarixini tozalash uchun quyidagi tugmani bosing:", {
  reply_markup: {
    keyboard: [[{ text: "🧹 Chatni qanday tozalash mumkin?" }]],
    resize_keyboard: true,
    one_time_keyboard: true
  }
});
```

Keyin, foydalanuvchi shu tugmani bosganda, siz unga yo‘riqnoma yuborasiz:

```ts
if (ctx.message.text === "🧹 Chatni qanday tozalash mumkin?") {
  await ctx.reply(
    `Chat tarixini tozalash uchun Telegram ilovasida:\n\n` +
    `1. Chatni oching\n` +
    `2. Yuqoridagi 3 nuqta yoki profilga bosing\n` +
    `3. "Clear chat history" yoki "Delete chat" tugmasini tanlang`
  );
}
```

---

### ✨ Qo‘shimcha G‘oya (inline button bilan):

Siz **inline keyboard** orqali ham yo‘riqnoma berishingiz mumkin:

```ts
await ctx.reply("Chatni tozalashni xohlaysizmi?", {
  reply_markup: {
    inline_keyboard: [
      [{ text: "Tozalash bo‘yicha yo‘riqnoma", callback_data: "clear_help" }]
    ]
  }
});
```

Keyin callback handlerda:

```ts
@Action("clear_help")
async onClearHelp(@Ctx() ctx: Context) {
  await ctx.answerCbQuery();
  await ctx.reply(
    "Chat tarixini o‘chirish uchun Telegram ilovasida chatni oching va 'Clear chat history' tugmasini tanlang."
  );
}
```

---

### 🧠 Xulosa:

| Narsa                         | Mumkinmi? | Izoh |
|------------------------------|-----------|------|
| `request_contact` kabi `request_clear_chat` | ❌ Yo‘q     | Telegram ruxsat bermaydi |
| Tugma orqali tozalashni boshlatish        | ❌ Yo‘q     | Faqat foydalanuvchi o‘zi bajara oladi |
| Tugma orqali yo‘riqnoma berish             | ✅ Ha      | Juda samarali alternativ |

---

Agar sizga tozalashga oid klaviatura interfeysini chiroyli qilishda yordam kerak bo‘lsa, tayyor kod bilan beraman. Shu variantni qurasizmi?

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

Aynan userning chatiga tegishli messagelarning id larini qandaya olalaman

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Telegram Bot API orqali **foydalanuvchi bilan bot o‘rtasidagi suhbatdagi barcha xabar IDlarini avtomatik tarzda olishning iloji yo‘q**. Ammo siz:

### ✅ Har bir kelgan va yuborilgan xabarning `message_id`sini real vaqtda olish va saqlab borishingiz mumkin.

---

### 💡 Foydalanuvchi yuborgan xabarni qanday olish mumkin?

Har bir `text` yoki `contact` yoki boshqa xabarni ushlaganingizda `ctx.message.message_id` orqali xabar ID’ni olasiz:

```ts
@On("text")
async onText(@Ctx() ctx: Context) {
  const messageId = ctx.message.message_id;
  const fromId = ctx.from.id;

  console.log(`User ${fromId} sent message ID: ${messageId}`);

  // Xabar ID’ni saqlang (masalan, DB yoki arrayga)
}
```

---

### 🧾 Misol: Xabar ID’larni array’da vaqtincha saqlash

```ts
const userMessages = new Map<number, number[]>();

@On("text")
async onText(@Ctx() ctx: Context) {
  const userId = ctx.from.id;
  const messageId = ctx.message.message_id;

  if (!userMessages.has(userId)) {
    userMessages.set(userId, []);
  }

  userMessages.get(userId).push(messageId);

  // Keyinchalik "Clear" komandasi kelganda o‘chirasiz:
  if (ctx.message.text === "Clear") {
    const ids = userMessages.get(userId) || [];
    for (const id of ids) {
      try {
        await ctx.telegram.deleteMessage(userId, id);
      } catch (e) {
        console.log(`Xabarni o‘chirishda xatolik: ${e.message}`);
      }
    }
    userMessages.set(userId, []);
    await ctx.reply("Xabarlaringiz tozalandi.");
  }
}
```

> ❗ Diqqat: bu usul **faqat bot o‘zi yuborgan xabarlarni o‘chiradi**, foydalanuvchi yuborganlarini emas (Telegram cheklovi).

---

### 🤖 Agar siz bot yuborgan xabarlarni ham kuzatmoqchi bo‘lsangiz:

```ts
const msg = await ctx.reply("Bu test xabar");
const messageId = msg.message_id;

// Saqlang, keyinchalik o‘chirish uchun
```

---

### 🧠 Xulosa

| Maqsad                          | Mumkinmi? | Izoh |
|-------------------------------|-----------|------|
| Foydalanuvchi yuborgan xabar ID’ni olish | ✅ Ha       | `ctx.message.message_id` orqali |
| Bot yuborgan xabar ID’ni olish          | ✅ Ha       | `ctx.reply()` natijasidan |
| Chatdagi barcha eski xabar ID’ni olish  | ❌ Yo‘q     | Telegram API bunday imkoniyat bermaydi |
| Foydalanuvchi yuborgan xabarni o‘chirish | ❌ Yo‘q     | Private chatda faqat foydalanuvchi o‘chiradi |

---

Agar sizga bu xabar ID’larni saqlashni doimiy (masalan, Redis yoki Prisma DB) qilish kerak bo‘lsa — kod namunalarini beraman. Shu yo‘nalishda davom etamizmi?

---

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Siz olgan xatolik quyidagini anglatadi:

> ❌ **`TelegramError: 400: Bad Request: message to delete not found`**

Bu xato **`ctx.telegram.deleteMessage(chat_id, message_id)`** chaqiruvining noto‘g‘ri bajarilganidan darak beradi.

---

### 📌 Xatolik sabablari va yechimlari:

#### 1. **message_id mavjud emas yoki noto‘g‘ri**
> Xato: `message_id: 1`

- Bu ID Telegram’da mavjud xabarga tegishli emas.
- `message_id` faqat sizning bot yuborgan xabaringiz uchun to‘g‘ri bo‘lishi kerak.
- Agar foydalanuvchi yuborgan xabarni o‘chirmoqchi bo‘lsangiz — **Telegram buni ruxsat bermaydi** (private chatda).

**✅ Yechim:**
Bot **o‘zi yuborgan xabar** quyidagicha olinadi:

```ts
const sent = await ctx.reply("Salom");
console.log(sent.message_id); // Shu ID’ni o‘chirish mumkin
await ctx.telegram.deleteMessage(ctx.chat.id, sent.message_id);
```

---

#### 2. **Xabar allaqachon o‘chirilgan yoki muddati o‘tgan**
> Telegram botlar faqat **48 soat** ichidagi o‘zlari yuborgan xabarlarni o‘chira oladi.

---

#### 3. **Bot yuborgan emas**
Bot faqat **o‘zi yuborgan xabarlarni** o‘chira oladi.
Foydalanuvchi yuborgan xabarlar:
```ts
ctx.message.message_id // ❌ Bu ID bo‘yicha o‘chirish ishlamaydi
```

---

### ✅ To‘g‘ri ishlaydigan namunaviy kod:

```ts
@On("text")
async onText(@Ctx() ctx: Context) {
  const msg = await ctx.reply("Bu xabar 3 soniyada o'chiriladi");

  setTimeout(async () => {
    try {
      await ctx.telegram.deleteMessage(ctx.chat.id, msg.message_id);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Xabarni o‘chirishda xatolik:", err);
    }
  }, 3000);
}
```

---

### 📦 Bonus: Faqat o‘z yuborganlarini saqlash

```ts
const sentMessageIds = new Map<number, number[]>(); // userId -> [message_id]

const sent = await ctx.reply("Salom");
const userId = ctx.from.id;

if (!sentMessageIds.has(userId)) sentMessageIds.set(userId, []);
sentMessageIds.get(userId).push(sent.message_id);
```

Keyin, `Clear` kelganda:

```ts
const ids = sentMessageIds.get(userId) || [];
for (const id of ids) {
  try {
    await ctx.telegram.deleteMessage(ctx.chat.id, id);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log("O‘chirib bo‘lmadi:", err.message);
  }
}
sentMessageIds.set(userId, []);
```

Agar xohlasangiz, **`/start` bosilganda barcha eski xabarlarni avtomatik tozalash** bo‘yicha modul ham yozib beraman.

Sizda ayni damda `message_id: 1` noto‘g‘ri ishlatilgan — uni bot yuborgan xabardan dinamik ravishda olish kerak. Shu bo‘yicha davom etamizmi?

# Prisma schema definition

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum ChatType {
  user_chat
  group_chat
  channel_chat
  bot_chat
}

model User {
  id       String  @id @default(uuid())
  username String? @unique
  email    String

  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  isDeleted Boolean @default(false) @map("is_deleted")
  isBot     Boolean @default(false) @map("is_bot")

  ownedGroupChats      GroupChat[]
  ownedChannelChats    ChannelChat[]
  userChat1            UserChat[]            @relation("UserChat1")
  userChat2            UserChat[]            @relation("UserChat2")
  sentMessages         MessageDetails[]
  botDetails           BotDetails[]          @relation("BotOwner")
  botParents           BotDetails[]          @relation("BotParent")
  botSubscriptions     BotSubscription[]
  channelSubscriptions ChannelSubscription[]
  groupSubscriptions   GroupSubscription[]
  Avatar               Avatar[]
  Profile              Profile[]

  @@index([username])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([isBot])
  @@map("users")
}

model Profile {
  id        String  @id @default(uuid())
  firstName String? @map("first_name")
  lastName  String? @map("last_name")
  bio       String? // User bio/description

  publicUrl  String? @map("public_url") // Public profile URL
  privateUrl String? @map("private_url") // Private referral URL

  userId   String
  user     User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  avatarId String
  avatar   Avatar? @relation(fields: [avatarId], references: [id])

  @@map("profile")
}

model Avatar {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  file      String // image url
  ownerId   String   @map("owner_id")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  owner   User      @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  Profile Profile[]

  @@map("avatars")
}

model ChatFile {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  file      String // file url
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  // Relations
  groupFiles    GroupFile[]
  channelFiles  ChannelFile[]
  userChatFiles UserChatFile[]

  @@map("chat_files")
}

model GroupFile {
  id     String @id @default(uuid())
  fileId String @map("file_id")
  chatId String @map("chat_id")

  // Relations
  file    ChatFile     @relation(fields: [fileId], references: [id])
  message MessageGroup @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])

  @@map("group_files")
}

model ChannelFile {
  id     String @id @default(uuid())
  fileId String @map("file_id")
  chatId String @map("chat_id")

  // Relations
  file    ChatFile       @relation(fields: [fileId], references: [id])
  message MessageChannel @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])

  @@map("channel_files")
}

model UserChatFile {
  id     String @id @default(uuid())
  fileId String @map("file_id")
  chatId String @map("chat_id")

  // Relations
  file    ChatFile        @relation(fields: [fileId], references: [id])
  message MessageUserChat @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])

  @@map("user_chat_fiels")
}

model GroupChat {
  id                 String   @id @default(uuid())
  ownerId            String   @map("owner_id")
  type               ChatType @default(group_chat)
  title              String?
  description        String? // Group description
  publicUrl          String?  @map("public_url") // Public group URL
  privateUrl         String?  @map("private_url") // Private group URL
  subscriptionsCount BigInt   @default(0) @map("subscritions_count")
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt          DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  owner         User                @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  messages      MessageGroup[]
  subscriptions GroupSubscription[]

  @@index([ownerId])
  @@index([type])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([title])
  @@map("group_chat")
}

model ChannelChat {
  id                 String   @id @default(uuid())
  ownerId            String   @map("owner_id")
  subscriptionsCount BigInt   @default(0) @map("subscritions_count")
  type               ChatType @default(channel_chat)
  title              String?
  description        String? // Channel description
  publicUrl          String?  @map("public_url") // Public channel URL
  privateUrl         String?  @map("private_url") // Private channel URL
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt          DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  owner         User                  @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  messages      MessageChannel[]
  subscriptions ChannelSubscription[]

  @@index([ownerId])
  @@index([type])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([title])
  @@map("channel_chat")
}

model UserChat {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  user1Id   String   @map("user_1_id")
  user2Id   String   @map("user_2_id")
  type      ChatType @default(user_chat)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  user1    User              @relation("UserChat1", fields: [user1Id], references: [id])
  user2    User              @relation("UserChat2", fields: [user2Id], references: [id])
  messages MessageUserChat[]

  @@index([user1Id])
  @@index([user2Id])
  @@index([user1Id, user2Id])
  @@index([type])
  @@map("user_chat")
}

model MessageChannel {
  id         String  @id @default(uuid())
  chatId     String  @map("chat_id")
  replayId   String? @map("replay_id")
  mDetailsId String  @map("m_detailes_id")
  isUpdated  Boolean @default(false) @map("is_updated")
  isReading  Boolean @default(false) @map("is_reading")

  // Relations
  chat         ChannelChat      @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])
  replyTo      MessageChannel?  @relation("MessageReply", fields: [replayId], references: [id])
  replies      MessageChannel[] @relation("MessageReply")
  details      MessageDetails   @relation(fields: [mDetailsId], references: [id])
  channelFiles ChannelFile[]

  @@index([chatId])
  @@index([replayId])
  @@index([mDetailsId])
  @@index([chatId, mDetailsId])
  @@map("messages_channel")
}

model MessageGroup {
  id         String  @id @default(uuid())
  chatId     String  @map("chat_id")
  replayId   String? @map("replay_id")
  mDetailsId String  @map("m_detailes_id")
  isUpdated  Boolean @default(false) @map("is_updated")
  isReading  Boolean @default(false) @map("is_reading")

  // Relations
  chat       GroupChat      @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])
  replyTo    MessageGroup?  @relation("MessageReply", fields: [replayId], references: [id])
  replies    MessageGroup[] @relation("MessageReply")
  details    MessageDetails @relation(fields: [mDetailsId], references: [id])
  groupFiles GroupFile[]

  @@index([chatId])
  @@index([replayId])
  @@index([mDetailsId])
  @@index([chatId, mDetailsId])
  @@map("messages_group")
}

model MessageUserChat {
  id         String  @id @default(uuid())
  chatId     String  @map("chat_id")
  replayId   String? @map("replay_id")
  mDetailsId String  @map("m_detailes_id")
  isUpdated  Boolean @default(false) @map("is_updated")
  isReading  Boolean @default(false) @map("is_reading")

  // Relations
  chat          UserChat          @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])
  replyTo       MessageUserChat?  @relation("MessageReply", fields: [replayId], references: [id])
  replies       MessageUserChat[] @relation("MessageReply")
  details       MessageDetails    @relation(fields: [mDetailsId], references: [id])
  userChatFiles UserChatFile[]

  @@index([chatId])
  @@index([replayId])
  @@index([mDetailsId])
  @@index([chatId, mDetailsId])
  @@map("messages_user_chat")
}

model MessageDetails {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  senderId  String   @map("sender_id")
  text      String?
  images    Json?
  videos    Json?
  docs      Json?
  files     Json?
  stickers  Json?    @map("stikers")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  sender           User              @relation(fields: [senderId], references: [id])
  channelMessages  MessageChannel[]
  groupMessages    MessageGroup[]
  userChatMessages MessageUserChat[]

  @@index([senderId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([senderId, createdAt])
  @@map("message_detailes")
}

model BotDetails {
  id       String @id @default(uuid())
  parentId String @map("parrent_id")
  ownerId  String @map("owner_id")

  // Relations
  parent User @relation("BotParent", fields: [parentId], references: [id])
  owner  User @relation("BotOwner", fields: [ownerId], references: [id])

  @@map("bot_detailes")
}

model ChannelSubscription {
  id           String  @id @default(uuid())
  chatId       String  @map("chat_id")
  subscriberId String  @map("subscriber_id")
  isWrite      Boolean  @default(false)

  // Relations
  chat       ChannelChat @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])
  subscriber User        @relation(fields: [subscriberId], references: [id])

  @@index([chatId])
  @@index([subscriberId])
  @@index([chatId, subscriberId])
  @@map("channel_subscribtions")
}

model GroupSubscription {
  id           String @id @default(uuid())
  chatId       String @map("chat_id")
  subscriberId String @map("subscriber_id")

  // Relations
  chat       GroupChat @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])
  subscriber User      @relation(fields: [subscriberId], references: [id])

  @@index([chatId])
  @@index([subscriberId])
  @@index([chatId, subscriberId])
  @@map("group_subscribtions")
}

model BotSubscription {
  id           String @id @default(uuid())
  botId        String @map("bot_id")
  subscriberId String @map("subscriber_id")

  // Relations
  subscriber User   @relation(fields: [subscriberId], references: [id])
  userId     String

  @@index([botId])
  @@index([subscriberId])
  @@index([botId, subscriberId])
  @@map("bot_subscribtions")
}

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Ha, tushundim ✅  

Senda `MessageDetails` degan bitta asosiy jadval bor. Bu jadvalda **umumiy message content** saqlanadi:  

- `text`, `images`, `videos`, `docs`, `files`, `stickers`  
- `senderId` — kim yuborganini ko‘rsatadi  
- `createdAt`, `updatedAt`  

Lekin `MessageDetails` **o‘zi qaysi chatga tegishli ekanini bilmaydi**. Shu sababli u **3 xil junction model** bilan bog‘langan:  

1. **MessageChannel**  
   ```prisma
   details MessageDetails @relation(fields: [mDetailsId], references: [id])
   ```
   → `ChannelChat` ichidagi xabarlarni ifodalaydi.

2. **MessageGroup**  
   → `GroupChat` xabarlarini bog‘laydi.  

3. **MessageUserChat**  
   → `UserChat` (1:1 chat) uchun xabarlarni bog‘laydi.  

🔗 Ya’ni:  
- **MessageDetails** – umumiy xabar mazmuni (kontent).  
- **MessageChannel / MessageGroup / MessageUserChat** – shu kontentni **qaysi chat turida** yuborilganini ko‘rsatadigan “junction” model.  
- Har birida `replayId` ham bor → reply/repost qilish uchun self-relation ishlatilgan.  

👉 Bu dizayn natijasida xabarni bittalab yozasan (MessageDetails), keyin uni kerakli chat turiga mos junction jadvalga bog‘lab qo‘yasan. Shu orqali **content duplication** bo‘lmaydi.

Sening hozirgi strukturangda:

Sen endi **1 ta joinni kamaytirish** uchun `MessageDetails`ni olib tashlamoqchi ekansan va barcha `text`, `files`, `images`, `senderId`, `createdAt` kabi maydonlarni **to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri `MessageChannel` / `MessageGroup` / `MessageUserChat` ichida** saqlamoqchisan.  

🔧 Buning uchun qilinadigan ish:  

1. `MessageDetails` modelini **olib tashlash**.  
2. Har bir `Message*` jadvaliga quyidagi ustunlarni ko‘chirish:  
   - `senderId` → kim yuborganini ko‘rsatadi  
   - `text`, `images`, `videos`, `docs`, `files`, `stickers`  
   - `createdAt`, `updatedAt`  
3. `User` bilan relation qo‘shish (`senderId` orqali).

### Yangilangan model misol (`MessageChannel` uchun):

```prisma
model MessageChannel {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  chatId     String   @map("chat_id")
  replayId   String?  @map("replay_id")

  senderId   String   @map("sender_id")
  text       String?
  images     Json?
  videos     Json?
  docs       Json?
  files      Json?
  stickers   Json?    @map("stikers")

  isUpdated  Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_updated")
  isReading  Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_reading")
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  chat     ChannelChat      @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])
  replyTo  MessageChannel?  @relation("ChannelReply", fields: [replayId], references: [id])
  replies  MessageChannel[] @relation("ChannelReply")
  sender   User             @relation(fields: [senderId], references: [id])
  filesRel ChannelFile[]

  @@index([chatId])
  @@index([replayId])
  @@index([senderId])
  @@map("messages_channel")
}
```

### Shunga o‘xshash (`MessageGroup` va `MessageUserChat`) ham **xuddi shu fieldlarni ichiga oladi**.

👉 Biz `MessageDetails`dagi fieldlarni alohida `type MessageContent` qilib ajratamiz, keyin uchta `Message*` model ichida qayta ishlatamiz. Shunda **join bo‘lmaydi**, lekin **kod duplication ham kamayadi**.

### Yangi yechim:

```prisma
// Umumiy xabar mazmuni uchun type
type MessageContent {
  senderId  String   @map("sender_id")
  text      String?
  images    Json?
  videos    Json?
  docs      Json?
  files     Json?
  stickers  Json?    @map("stikers")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
}
```

### `MessageChannel`
```prisma
model MessageChannel {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  chatId    String   @map("chat_id")
  replayId  String?  @map("replay_id")

  // Umumiy xabar mazmuni
  content   MessageContent

  isUpdated Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_updated")
  isReading Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_reading")

  // Relations
  chat     ChannelChat      @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])
  replyTo  MessageChannel?  @relation("ChannelReply", fields: [replayId], references: [id])
  replies  MessageChannel[] @relation("ChannelReply")
  sender   User             @relation(fields: [content.senderId], references: [id])
  filesRel ChannelFile[]

  @@index([chatId])
  @@index([replayId])
  @@index([content.senderId])

}
```

⚠️ Lekin: Prisma `type` (composite) faqat **PostgreSQL va MongoDB** da ishlaydi. Sen Postgres ishlatyapsan, demak bemalol ishlaydi.

## To‘liq yangilangan tuzilma:

```prisma
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum ChatType {
  user_chat
  group_chat
  channel_chat
  bot_chat
}

model User {
  id       String  @id @default(uuid())
  username String? @unique
  email    String

  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  isDeleted Boolean @default(false) @map("is_deleted")
  isBot     Boolean @default(false) @map("is_bot")

  ownedGroupChats      GroupChat[]
  ownedChannelChats    ChannelChat[]
  userChat1            UserChat[]       @relation("UserChat1")
  userChat2            UserChat[]       @relation("UserChat2")
  sentChannelMessages  MessageChannel[]
  sentGroupMessages    MessageGroup[]
  sentUserMessages     MessageUserChat[]
  botDetails           BotDetails[]     @relation("BotOwner")
  botParents           BotDetails[]     @relation("BotParent")
  botSubscriptions     BotSubscription[]
  channelSubscriptions ChannelSubscription[]
  groupSubscriptions   GroupSubscription[]
  Avatar               Avatar[]
  Profile              Profile[]

  @@index([username])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([isBot])
  @@map("users")
}

model Profile {
  id        String  @id @default(uuid())
  firstName String? @map("first_name")
  lastName  String? @map("last_name")
  bio       String?

  publicUrl  String? @map("public_url")
  privateUrl String? @map("private_url")

  userId   String
  user     User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  avatarId String
  avatar   Avatar? @relation(fields: [avatarId], references: [id])

  @@map("profile")
}

model Avatar {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  file      String
  ownerId   String   @map("owner_id")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  owner   User      @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  Profile Profile[]

  @@map("avatars")
}

model ChatFile {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  file      String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  groupFiles    GroupFile[]
  channelFiles  ChannelFile[]
  userChatFiles UserChatFile[]

  @@map("chat_files")
}

model GroupFile {
  id     String @id @default(uuid())
  fileId String @map("file_id")
  chatId String @map("chat_id")

  file    ChatFile     @relation(fields: [fileId], references: [id])
  message MessageGroup @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])

  @@map("group_files")
}

model ChannelFile {
  id     String @id @default(uuid())
  fileId String @map("file_id")
  chatId String @map("chat_id")

  file    ChatFile       @relation(fields: [fileId], references: [id])
  message MessageChannel @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])

  @@map("channel_files")
}

model UserChatFile {
  id     String @id @default(uuid())
  fileId String @map("file_id")
  chatId String @map("chat_id")

  file    ChatFile        @relation(fields: [fileId], references: [id])
  message MessageUserChat @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])

  @@map("user_chat_files")
}

model GroupChat {
  id                 String   @id @default(uuid())
  ownerId            String   @map("owner_id")
  type               ChatType @default(group_chat)
  title              String?
  description        String?
  publicUrl          String?  @map("public_url")
  privateUrl         String?  @map("private_url")
  subscriptionsCount BigInt   @default(0) @map("subscritions_count")
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt          DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  owner         User                @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  messages      MessageGroup[]
  subscriptions GroupSubscription[]

  @@index([ownerId])
  @@index([type])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([title])
  @@map("group_chat")
}

model ChannelChat {
  id                 String   @id @default(uuid())
  ownerId            String   @map("owner_id")
  subscriptionsCount BigInt   @default(0) @map("subscritions_count")
  type               ChatType @default(channel_chat)
  title              String?
  description        String?
  publicUrl          String?  @map("public_url")
  privateUrl         String?  @map("private_url")
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt          DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  owner         User                  @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  messages      MessageChannel[]
  subscriptions ChannelSubscription[]

  @@index([ownerId])
  @@index([type])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([title])
  @@map("channel_chat")
}

model UserChat {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  user1Id   String   @map("user_1_id")
  user2Id   String   @map("user_2_id")
  type      ChatType @default(user_chat)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  user1    User              @relation("UserChat1", fields: [user1Id], references: [id])
  user2    User              @relation("UserChat2", fields: [user2Id], references: [id])
  messages MessageUserChat[]

  @@index([user1Id])
  @@index([user2Id])
  @@index([user1Id, user2Id])
  @@index([type])
  @@map("user_chat")
}

model MessageChannel {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  chatId    String   @map("chat_id")
  replayId  String?  @map("replay_id")

  senderId  String   @map("sender_id")
  text      String?
  images    Json?
  videos    Json?
  docs      Json?
  files     Json?
  stickers  Json?    @map("stikers")

  isUpdated Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_updated")
  isReading Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_reading")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  chat     ChannelChat      @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])
  replyTo  MessageChannel?  @relation("ChannelReply", fields: [replayId], references: [id])
  replies  MessageChannel[] @relation("ChannelReply")
  sender   User             @relation(fields: [senderId], references: [id])
  filesRel ChannelFile[]

  @@index([chatId])
  @@index([replayId])
  @@index([senderId])
  @@map("messages_channel")
}

model MessageGroup {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  chatId    String   @map("chat_id")
  replayId  String?  @map("replay_id")

  senderId  String   @map("sender_id")
  text      String?
  images    Json?
  videos    Json?
  docs      Json?
  files     Json?
  stickers  Json?    @map("stikers")

  isUpdated Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_updated")
  isReading Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_reading")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  chat     GroupChat      @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])
  replyTo  MessageGroup?  @relation("GroupReply", fields: [replayId], references: [id])
  replies  MessageGroup[] @relation("GroupReply")
  sender   User           @relation(fields: [senderId], references: [id])
  filesRel GroupFile[]

  @@index([chatId])
  @@index([replayId])
  @@index([senderId])
  @@map("messages_group")
}

model MessageUserChat {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  chatId    String   @map("chat_id")
  replayId  String?  @map("replay_id")

  senderId  String   @map("sender_id")
  text      String?
  images    Json?
  videos    Json?
  docs      Json?
  files     Json?
  stickers  Json?    @map("stikers")

  isUpdated Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_updated")
  isReading Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_reading")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  chat     UserChat          @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])
  replyTo  MessageUserChat?  @relation("UserChatReply", fields: [replayId], references: [id])
  replies  MessageUserChat[] @relation("UserChatReply")
  sender   User              @relation(fields: [senderId], references: [id])
  filesRel UserChatFile[]

  @@index([chatId])
  @@index([replayId])
  @@index([senderId])
  @@map("messages_user_chat")
}

model BotDetails {
  id       String @id @default(uuid())
  parentId String @map("parrent_id")
  ownerId  String @map("owner_id")

  parent User @relation("BotParent", fields: [parentId], references: [id])
  owner  User @relation("BotOwner", fields: [ownerId], references: [id])

  @@map("bot_detailes")
}

model ChannelSubscription {
  id           String  @id @default(uuid())
  chatId       String  @map("chat_id")
  subscriberId String  @map("subscriber_id")
  isWrite      Boolean @default(false)

  chat       ChannelChat @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])
  subscriber User        @relation(fields: [subscriberId], references: [id])

  @@index([chatId])
  @@index([subscriberId])
  @@index([chatId, subscriberId])
  @@map("channel_subscribtions")
}

model GroupSubscription {
  id           String @id @default(uuid())
  chatId       String @map("chat_id")
  subscriberId String @map("subscriber_id")

  chat       GroupChat @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])
  subscriber User      @relation(fields: [subscriberId], references: [id])

  @@index([chatId])
  @@index([subscriberId])
  @@index([chatId, subscriberId])
  @@map("group_subscribtions")
}

model BotSubscription {
  id           String @id @default(uuid())
  botId        String @map("bot_id")
  subscriberId String @map("subscriber_id")

  subscriber User   @relation(fields: [subscriberId], references: [id])
  userId     String

  @@index([botId])
  @@index([subscriberId])
  @@index([botId, subscriberId])
  @@map("bot_subscribtions")
}
```

✅ Endi:  
- `MessageDetails` olib tashlandi.  
- Har bir `Message*` jadval o‘zida kontentni saqlaydi.  
- Join kamaydi → query soddalashdi.

## 📌 To‘liq Prisma Schema (soddalashtirilgan)

```prisma
// =====================
// User
// =====================
model User {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  username  String   @unique
  email     String?  @unique
  password  String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  userChats    UserChat[]
  groupChats   GroupChat[]
  channelChats ChannelChat[]

  sentMessagesChannel MessageChannel[] @relation("UserChannelMessages")
  sentMessagesGroup   MessageGroup[]   @relation("UserGroupMessages")
  sentMessagesUser    MessageUserChat[] @relation("UserUserChatMessages")
}

// =====================
// Chats
// =====================
model UserChat {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  user1Id   String
  user2Id   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  // Relations
  user1   User @relation("UserChatUser1", fields: [user1Id], references: [id])
  user2   User @relation("UserChatUser2", fields: [user2Id], references: [id])
  messages MessageUserChat[]
}

model GroupChat {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  name      String
  ownerId   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  owner    User          @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  members  User[]
  messages MessageGroup[]
}

model ChannelChat {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  name      String
  ownerId   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  owner    User            @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  messages MessageChannel[]
}

// =====================
// Messages
// =====================

model MessageChannel {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  chatId    String   @map("chat_id")
  senderId  String   @map("sender_id")
  replayId  String?  @map("replay_id")

  text      String?
  images    Json?
  videos    Json?
  docs      Json?
  files     Json?
  stickers  Json?    @map("stikers")

  isUpdated Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_updated")
  isReading Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_reading")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  chat     ChannelChat      @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])
  sender   User             @relation("UserChannelMessages", fields: [senderId], references: [id])
  replyTo  MessageChannel?  @relation("ChannelReply", fields: [replayId], references: [id])
  replies  MessageChannel[] @relation("ChannelReply")

  @@index([chatId])
  @@index([senderId])
  @@map("messages_channel")
}

model MessageGroup {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  chatId    String   @map("chat_id")
  senderId  String   @map("sender_id")
  replayId  String?  @map("replay_id")

  text      String?
  images    Json?
  videos    Json?
  docs      Json?
  files     Json?
  stickers  Json?    @map("stikers")

  isUpdated Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_updated")
  isReading Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_reading")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  chat     GroupChat      @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])
  sender   User           @relation("UserGroupMessages", fields: [senderId], references: [id])
  replyTo  MessageGroup?  @relation("GroupReply", fields: [replayId], references: [id])
  replies  MessageGroup[] @relation("GroupReply")

  @@index([chatId])
  @@index([senderId])
  @@map("messages_group")
}

model MessageUserChat {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  chatId    String   @map("chat_id")
  senderId  String   @map("sender_id")
  replayId  String?  @map("replay_id")

  text      String?
  images    Json?
  videos    Json?
  docs      Json?
  files     Json?
  stickers  Json?    @map("stikers")

  isUpdated Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_updated")
  isReading Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_reading")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  chat     UserChat          @relation(fields: [chatId], references: [id])
  sender   User              @relation("UserUserChatMessages", fields: [senderId], references: [id])
  replyTo  MessageUserChat?  @relation("UserChatReply", fields: [replayId], references: [id])
  replies  MessageUserChat[] @relation("UserChatReply")

  @@index([chatId])
  @@index([senderId])
  @@map("messages_user_chat")
}
```

✅ Endi:  
- **Hech qanday `MessageDetails` yoki `File` jadval yo‘q**.  
- Barcha fayl, media, text kontentlari **to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri `Message*` jadvalida saqlanadi**.  
- `UserChat`, `GroupChat`, `ChannelChat` har biri o‘z `messages` bilan bog‘langan.  
- Reply (`replayId`) self-relation orqali ishlaydi.

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

Messageslar uchun interseptorni qanday yozisim kerak

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Zo‘r savol 😎  

Agar sen NestJS’da `Messages` moduli bilan ishlayotgan bo‘lsang (masalan, `MessageChannel`, `MessageGroup`, `MessageUserChat` uchun), **interceptor** yozish orqali xabarlarni yuborishdan yoki olishdan oldin/so‘ng **ma’lumotni avtomatik qayta ishlash** mumkin.

Quyida senga **universal message interceptor** yozib beraman, u barcha message’lar uchun ishlaydi.

---

## ⚙️ Maqsad:
- Har bir message create/update request’dan oldin avtomatik `senderId` qo‘shish (masalan, `req.user.id` dan).
- Fayllar, media, textni validatsiya qilish.
- Response’da ma’lumotni formatlash (masalan, `JSON` fieldlarni parse qilib yuborish).

---

## 🧩 Universal `MessagesInterceptor`

```ts
import {
  CallHandler,
  ExecutionContext,
  Injectable,
  NestInterceptor,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Observable, map } from 'rxjs';

@Injectable()
export class MessagesInterceptor implements NestInterceptor {
  intercept(context: ExecutionContext, next: CallHandler): Observable<any> {
    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();

    // 🔹 1. Kiruvchi message ma'lumotni tozalash / formatlash
    if (request.body) {
      const body = request.body;

      // Agar auth'dan foydalanuvchi kelsa, senderId'ni avtomatik qo'shamiz
      if (request.user && !body.senderId) {
        body.senderId = request.user.id;
      }

      // Fayl, media, sticker, docs kabilarni JSON string bo‘lsa parse qilamiz
      for (const key of ['files', 'images', 'videos', 'docs', 'stickers']) {
        if (typeof body[key] === 'string') {
          try {
            body[key] = JSON.parse(body[key]);
          } catch {
            body[key] = null;
          }
        }
      }

      request.body = body;
    }

    // 🔹 2. Response qaytganda formatlash
    return next.handle().pipe(
      map((data) => {
        // Agar ma'lumot message bo‘lsa, JSON fieldlarni parse qilamiz
        if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
          for (const key of ['files', 'images', 'videos', 'docs', 'stickers']) {
            if (typeof data[key] === 'string') {
              try {
                data[key] = JSON.parse(data[key]);
              } catch {
                // Agar JSON emas bo‘lsa, o‘z holicha qoldiramiz
              }
            }
          }
        }
        return data;
      }),
    );
  }
}
```

---

## 🧱 Interceptorni qo‘llash

Agar bu interceptor **faqat message controller** uchun kerak bo‘lsa:

```ts
import { UseInterceptors } from '@nestjs/common';
import { MessagesInterceptor } from './interceptors/messages.interceptor';

@Controller('messages')
@UseInterceptors(MessagesInterceptor)
export class MessagesController {
  constructor(private readonly messagesService: MessagesService) {}

  @Post('channel')
  createChannelMessage(@Body() body: any) {
    return this.messagesService.createChannelMessage(body);
  }

  @Post('group')
  createGroupMessage(@Body() body: any) {
    return this.messagesService.createGroupMessage(body);
  }

  @Post('user')
  createUserMessage(@Body() body: any) {
    return this.messagesService.createUserMessage(body);
  }
}
```

`main.ts` ichida:


- `files`, `images`, `videos` kabi maydonlar avtomatik parse/format qilinadi.
- Response foydalanuvchiga toza formatda qaytadi.

```ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';

import { UpdateMessageDto } from './dto/update-message.dto';
```

## ⚙️ 3. `messages.interceptor.ts`

Bu interceptor har bir request’da:
- `req.user` dan `senderId` ni qo‘shadi.
- `text` yoki boshqa media ma’lumotlarini JSON qilib parse qiladi.
- Response’ni formatlab beradi.

```ts
import {
  CallHandler,
  ExecutionContext,
  Injectable,
  NestInterceptor,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Observable, map } from 'rxjs';

@Injectable()
export class MessagesInterceptor implements NestInterceptor {
  intercept(context: ExecutionContext, next: CallHandler): Observable<any> {
    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();

    if (request.body) {
      const body = request.body;

      // 🔹 senderId ni avtomatik qo‘shamiz
      if (request.user && !body.senderId) {
        body.senderId = request.user.id;
      }

      // 🔹 Agar JSON bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan fieldlar string bo‘lsa, parse qilamiz
      for (const key of ['files', 'images', 'videos', 'docs', 'stickers']) {
        if (typeof body[key] === 'string') {
          try {
            body[key] = JSON.parse(body[key]);
          } catch {
            body[key] = null;
          }
        }
      }

      request.body = body;
    }

    return next.handle().pipe(
      map((data) => {
        if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
          // Response formatlash
          for (const key of ['files', 'images', 'videos', 'docs', 'stickers']) {
            if (typeof data[key] === 'string') {
              try {
                data[key] = JSON.parse(data[key]);
              } catch {
                // JSON emas — o‘zgartirmaymiz
              }
            }
          }
        }
        return data;
      }),
    );
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from 'src/prisma.service';
import { CreateMessageDto } from './dto/create-message.dto';
import { UpdateMessageDto } from './dto/update-message.dto';

@Injectable()
export class MessagesService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  async createUserMessage(dto: CreateMessageDto) {
    return this.prisma.messageUserChat.create({
      data: {
        chatId: dto.chatId,
        senderId: dto.senderId,
        replayId: dto.replayId,
        text: dto.text,
      },
    });
  }

  async createGroupMessage(dto: CreateMessageDto) {
    return this.prisma.messageGroup.create({
      data: {
        chatId: dto.chatId,
        senderId: dto.senderId,
        replayId: dto.replayId,
        text: dto.text,
      },
    });
  }

  async createChannelMessage(dto: CreateMessageDto) {
    return this.prisma.messageChannel.create({
      data: {
        chatId: dto.chatId,
        senderId: dto.senderId,
        replayId: dto.replayId,
        text: dto.text,
      },
    });
  }

  async updateMessage(id: string, dto: UpdateMessageDto) {
    // universal update
    return this.prisma.messageUserChat.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        text: dto.text,
        isUpdated: dto.isUpdated ?? true,
      },
    });
  }
}
```

`toLocaleString()` xatolik berayotganining sababi **birinchi argument noto‘g‘ri berilganidan**.  

- `toLocaleString()` ning **birinchi parametri** — locale (masalan `"en-US"`, `"uz-UZ"`, `"ru-RU"`).  
- Siz esa ` {region : ""}` kabi obyekt yuborgansiz, bu noto‘g‘ri.  

To‘g‘ri ishlashi uchun misol:  
- `today.toLocaleString("uz-UZ", { weekday: "long" })` → `"dushanba"`.  
- `today.toLocaleString("en-US", { month: "long" })` → `"September"`.  

Ya’ni birinchi argument **string** bo‘lishi kerak, `object` emas.  

Siz `region` deb berayotgan joyni `"uz-UZ"` yoki `"en-US"` kabi locale bilan almashtirsangiz, xatolik yo‘qoladi.

function getLessonDays(startDate: Date, monthDuration: number) {

    const target = new Date(startDate.toISOString())
    const end = new Date(startDate.toISOString())
    target.setMonth(startDate.getMonth() + monthDuration)

    let days = []
    while (target < end) {

        if ([1, 3, 5].includes(target.getDay())) {

                    inDigit: target.getDay(),
                    inString: target.toLocaleString("en-US", { weekday: "long" })
                },
                year: target.getFullYear(),
                month: {
                    inDigit: target.getMonth(),
                    inString: target.toLocaleString("en-US", { month: "long" })
                }
            })
        }
    }

    console.log(target.getDay())
    return days
}

### 🔧 Tuzatilgan kod
```ts
import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client"
import { NextResponse } from "next/server"

const prisma = new PrismaClient()

function getLessonDays(startDate: Date, monthDuration: number) {
  const target = new Date(startDate.toISOString())
  const end = new Date(startDate.toISOString())
  end.setMonth(startDate.getMonth() + monthDuration)

  // startDate ni eng yaqin dushanba/chorshanba/juma qilish
  while (![1, 3, 5].includes(target.getDay())) {
    target.setDate(target.getDate() + 1)
  }

  let days: any[] = []
  while (target <= end) {
    days.push({
      date: target.toISOString().split("T")[0],
      weekday: {
        inDigit: target.getDay(),
        inString: target.toLocaleString("en-US", { weekday: "long" })
      },
      year: target.getFullYear(),
      month: {
        inDigit: target.getMonth(),
        inString: target.toLocaleString("en-US", { month: "long" })
      }
    })
    const day = target.getDay()
    const adder = day === 5 ? 3 : 2
    target.setDate(target.getDate() + adder)
  }

  return days
}

export async function GET(
  req: Request,
  context: { params: Promise<{ groupId: string }> }
) {
  const { groupId } = await context.params
  const group = await prisma.group.findUnique({
    where: {
      id: parseInt(groupId)
    }
  })

  if (!group) {
    return NextResponse.json({ message: "Group not found!" })
  } else {
    const days = getLessonDays(group.startDate, group.monthDuration)
    return NextResponse.json({
      ...group,
      lessonDays: days
    })
  }
}
```

### 🔧 Masalan:
```ts
function getLessonDays(startDate: Date, monthDuration: number) {
  const target = new Date(startDate.toISOString())
  const end = new Date(startDate.toISOString())
  end.setMonth(startDate.getMonth() + monthDuration)

  const daysOfWeek = [1, 3, 5] // dushanba, chorshanba, juma

  // agar startDate dars kuni bo‘lmasa → keyingi dars kunini top
  while (!daysOfWeek.includes(target.getDay())) {
    target.setDate(target.getDate() + 1)
  }

  let days: any[] = []
  while (target <= end) {
    days.push({
      date: target.toISOString().split("T")[0],
      weekday: {
        inDigit: target.getDay(),
        inString: target.toLocaleString("en-US", { weekday: "long" })
      },
      year: target.getFullYear(),
      month: {
        inDigit: target.getMonth(),
        inString: target.toLocaleString("en-US", { month: "long" })
      }
    })

    const day = target.getDay()
    // keyingi dars kuni: agar juma bo‘lsa +3, aks holda +2
    const adder = day === daysOfWeek[2] ? 3 : 2
    target.setDate(target.getDate() + adder)
  }

  return days
}
```

- Masalan, agar keyin seshanbani ham qo‘shmoqchi bo‘lsangiz → `const daysOfWeek = [1, 2, 3, 5]`.

        target.setDate(target.getDate() + 1)
    }

    while (target < end) {
        days.push({

            weekday: {

                inString: target.toLocaleString("en-US", { weekday: "long" })
            },
            year: target.getFullYear(),
            month: {
                inDigit: target.getMonth(),
                inString: target.toLocaleString("en-US", { month: "long" })
            }
        })
        const day = target.getDay()
        const adder = day === 5 ? 3 : 2
        target.setDate(target.getDate() + adder) 
    }

        date : string,
        weekday : {
            inDigit : number,
            inString : string
        },
        year : number,
        month :  {
            inDigit : number,

        },
    }[]> = {}

export async function GET(req: Request, context: { params: Promise<{ groupId: string }> }) {
    const { groupId } = await context.params
    const group = await prisma.group.findUnique({
        where: {
            id: parseInt(groupId)
        }
    })
    if (!group) {
        return NextResponse.json({
            message: "Group not found !"
        })
    } else {

```ts
    const target = new Date(startDate.toISOString())
```

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Haa, endi `daysOffWeek` parametrini qo‘shib qo‘ygansiz 👌. Lekin hozirgi implementatsiyada ikkita muammo bor:  

1. Siz `weeks` va `task` ni hisoblayapsiz, lekin ularni ishlatmayapsiz. Hali ham `while (![1,3,5]...)` va `day === 5 ? 3 : 2` qismi eski qolgani.  
2. Shuning uchun hozir hamisha faqat `[1,3,5]` (dushanba, chorshanba, juma) bo‘yicha ishlayapti, `[2,4,6]` (seshanba, payshanba, shanba) varianti ishlamayapti.

### 🔧 To‘g‘rilash varianti
Siz `daysOffWeek` ni juft/toq qilib tekshirganingiz yaxshi, endi uni ishlatish kerak:  

```ts
function getLessonDays(startDate: Date, monthDuration: number, daysOffWeek: number) {
    const target = new Date(startDate.toISOString())
    const end = new Date(startDate.toISOString())
    end.setMonth(startDate.getMonth() + monthDuration)

    // Agar daysOffWeek toq bo‘lsa -> [1,3,5], juft bo‘lsa -> [2,4,6]
    const lessonDays = daysOffWeek % 2 ? [1, 3, 5] : [2, 4, 6]

    // Boshlanishini mos kunlardan biriga olib boramiz
    while (!lessonDays.includes(target.getDay())) {
        target.setDate(target.getDate() + 1)
    }

    let days: {
        date: string,
        weekday: { inDigit: number, inString: string },
        year: number,
        month: { inDigit: number, inString: string }
    }[] = []

    let daysInMonth: Record<string, typeof days> = {}

    while (target < end) {
        const inStringMonth = target.toLocaleString("en-US", { month: "long" })

        const obj = {
            date: target.toISOString().split("T")[0],
            weekday: {
                inDigit: target.getDay(),
                inString: target.toLocaleString("en-US", { weekday: "long" })
            },
            year: target.getFullYear(),
            month: {
                inDigit: target.getMonth(),
                inString: inStringMonth
            }
        }

        days.push(obj)

        if (!daysInMonth[inStringMonth]) {
            daysInMonth[inStringMonth] = []
        }
        daysInMonth[inStringMonth].push(obj)

        // Keyingi kunga o‘tkazish:
        // Agar oxirgi kun bo‘lsa (lessonDays massivining oxiri) -> oraliqni boshqa formula bo‘yicha oshirish
        const currentIndex = lessonDays.indexOf(target.getDay())
        const nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % lessonDays.length
        const adder = (lessonDays[nextIndex] - target.getDay() + 7) % 7 || 7
        target.setDate(target.getDate() + adder)
    }

    return { days, daysInMonth }
}
```

---

### 🔍 Qanday ishlaydi:
- Agar `daysOffWeek = 1` bo‘lsa → `[1,3,5]` (Du/Cho/Ju).  
- Agar `daysOffWeek = 2` bo‘lsa → `[2,4,6]` (Se/Pa/Sha).  
- `adder` endi **dinamik hisoblanadi**: masalan seshanbadan payshanbaga → +2 kun, payshanbadan shanbaga → +2 kun, shanbadan keyin seshanbaga → +3 kun.  

---

❓ Siz xohlaysizmi, `daysOffWeek` oddiy `boolean` (`true = [1,3,5]`, `false = [2,4,6]`) bo‘lib ketsin, yoki shu tarzda `number` (`1` / `2`) bo‘lib qolaversin?

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

bundan ko'ra setDate ga +1 qilish yechimni oshonlashtiradi baribir muammo ko'payayabdi chunki kunlar dinamik :xd

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

To‘g‘ri gap 🤝 — siz `setDate(+1)` qilib oddiygina **har kuni yurib chiqish** variantini tanlasangiz, kod ancha soddalashadi. Chunki sizning `lessonDays` massivida qaysi kunlar kerakligi bor, qolganlarini tashlab ketasiz. Hech qanday `+2`, `+3` yoki sikl hisoblash shart emas.  

Masalan 👇

```ts
function getLessonDays(startDate: Date, monthDuration: number, daysOffWeek: number) {
    const target = new Date(startDate.toISOString())
    const end = new Date(startDate.toISOString())
    end.setMonth(startDate.getMonth() + monthDuration)

    // lessonDays -> dars kunlari (toq yoki juft)
    const lessonDays = daysOffWeek % 2 ? [1, 3, 5] : [2, 4, 6]

    let days: {
        date: string,
        weekday: { inDigit: number, inString: string },
        year: number,
        month: { inDigit: number, inString: string }
    }[] = []

    let daysInMonth: Record<string, typeof days> = {}

    while (target < end) {
        if (lessonDays.includes(target.getDay())) {
            const inStringMonth = target.toLocaleString("en-US", { month: "long" })
            const obj = {
                date: target.toISOString().split("T")[0],
                weekday: {
                    inDigit: target.getDay(),
                    inString: target.toLocaleString("en-US", { weekday: "long" })
                },
                year: target.getFullYear(),
                month: {
                    inDigit: target.getMonth(),
                    inString: inStringMonth
                }
            }

            days.push(obj)

            if (!daysInMonth[inStringMonth]) {
                daysInMonth[inStringMonth] = []
            }
            daysInMonth[inStringMonth].push(obj)
        }

        // har doim faqat bitta kun oldinga yuramiz
        target.setDate(target.getDate() + 1)
    }

    return { days, daysInMonth }
}
```

🔑 Afzalliklari:  
- Endi `day === 5 ? 3 : 2` kabi maxsus case’lar kerak emas.  
- Dars kunlari ro‘yxati (`[1,3,5]` yoki `[2,4,6]`) o‘zi filtr qilib beradi.  
- Kutilmagan bug’lar kamayadi.

endi adminActions da data.user_id keyboardga birictirib action da olish

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Agar siz `adminActionsKeyvords` funksiyasida `user_id` ma'lumotini `callback_data`ga biriktirmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, va uni `@Action(/update_user/)` handlerda olishni xohlasangiz, `callback_data` ni shu ko‘rinishda jo‘natishingiz kerak: `update_user:<user_id>`. Quyida kerakli o‘zgarishlar:

---

### ✅ 1. `adminActionsKeyvords` funksiyasini o‘zgartiring:

```ts
export const adminActionsKeyvords = (data: userResponseEntity) => {
    return {
        reply_markup: {
            inline_keyboard: [
                [
                    { text: "Delete user", callback_data: `delete_user:${data.user_id}` },
                    { text: "Update user", callback_data: `update_user:${data.user_id}` }
                ]
            ]
        }
    }
}
```

---

### ✅ 2. `@Action(/update_user/)` funksiyasida `user_id` ni ajratish:

```ts
@Action(/update_user/)
async checkActionsAdmin(@Ctx() ctx: Context) {
    try {
        const callbackData = ctx.callbackQuery?.data; // Masalan: "update_user:12345"
        let userId: string | undefined;

        if (callbackData) {
            const [, id] = callbackData.split(":"); // ["update_user", "12345"]
            userId = id;
        }

        await ctx.reply(`User ID: ${userId}`, {
            reply_markup: {
                inline_keyboard: [
                    [{ text: "Salom", callback_data: "salom_action" }]
                ]
            }
        });
    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Action Error", error);
        await ctx.reply("Xatolik yuz berdi");
    }
}
```

---

Shunda `callback_data` orqali yuborilgan `user_id` to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri handlerga kiradi va siz uni ishlatishingiz mumkin bo‘ladi.

Agar xohlasangiz `delete_user` uchun ham xuddi shunday ishlov berish qo‘shamiz. Ayting, kerak bo‘lsa.

---

Kodingizda ba'zi muhim joylarga aniqlik kiritish kerak, chunki quyidagi muammolar bor:

---

### ❗️Muammolar:

1. `ctx.message` mavjud bo‘lmaydi, chunki `@Action(...)` `callbackQuery` ustida ishlaydi — ya'ni `ctx.callbackQuery.message` dan foydalanish kerak.
2. `ctx.telegram.deleteMessage(id, messageId)` noto‘g‘ri: `id` bu yerda `user_id`, lekin kerakli narsa bu chat ID (`chat.id`) bo'lishi kerak.
3. `ctx.reply(...)` o‘rniga `ctx.telegram.sendMessage(...)` ishlatgan ma’qul, chunki `ctx.reply` kontekstni buzishi mumkin `callbackQuery`da.
4. `ctx.reply(error)` — bu `error` obyektni string emas. Uni `String(error)` yoki `console.error(error)` qilish kerak.

### ✅ To‘g‘rilangan versiya:

```ts
@Action(/update_user/)
async checkActionsAdminUpdate(@Ctx() ctx: Context) {
    try {
        const callbackData = ctx.callbackQuery?.data; // "update_user:12345"
        const id = callbackData?.split(":")[1]; // foydalanuvchi ID

        const chatId = ctx.callbackQuery?.message?.chat.id;
        const messageId = ctx.callbackQuery?.message?.message_id;

        const user = await this.userService.findByTelegramId(id);
        const result = await this.userService.updateUser(id, {
            role: !user?.role
        });

        if (chatId && messageId) {
            await ctx.telegram.deleteMessage(chatId, messageId);
        }

        await ctx.telegram.sendMessage(chatId, response(result), adminPanel);

    } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        await ctx.reply('Xatolik yuz berdi');
    }
}
```

---

### Qo‘shimcha maslahat:

Agar siz `adminPanel` degan `reply_markup` obyektni ko‘p joyda ishlatsangiz — uni alohida modulda `export` qilib saqlagan yaxshi.

---

Agar `delete_user` uchun ham shunaqa funksiyani yozmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, ayting — tayyorlab beraman.

## Manba: `zdes_archive_docs/raw_history/skills/dto-validation-class-validator.md`

# Data Transfer Object (DTO) Validation Patterns

NestJS utilizes `class-validator` and `class-transformer` to provide robust, declarative validation pipelines. This ensures that only valid data reaches your controllers and services.

## 1. Setup Validation Pipe Globally

To enable DTO validation automatically across the entire application, configure the `ValidationPipe` in your `main.ts`.

```typescript
// src/main.ts
import { ValidationPipe } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import { AppModule } from './app.module';

async function bootstrap() {
  const app = await NestFactory.create(AppModule);
  
  app.useGlobalPipes(new ValidationPipe({
    whitelist: true, // Strips properties that do not have decorators
    forbidNonWhitelisted: true, // Throws an error if non-whitelisted properties are provided
    transform: true, // Automatically transforms payloads to DTO instances
  }));
  
  await app.listen(3000);
}
bootstrap();
```

## 2. Basic DTO Patterns

Use decorators from `class-validator` to define constraints.

```typescript
// src/users/dto/create-user.dto.ts
import { IsString, IsEmail, IsNotEmpty, MinLength, MaxLength, Matches } from 'class-validator';

export class CreateUserDto {
  @IsEmail({}, { message: 'Please provide a valid email address' })
  email: string;

  @IsString()
  @IsNotEmpty()
  @MinLength(2)
  @MaxLength(50)
  firstName: string;

  @IsString()
  @IsNotEmpty()
  @Matches(/((?=.*\d)|(?=.*\W+))(?![.\n])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*[a-z]).*$/, {
    message: 'Password must contain at least one uppercase, one lowercase, and one number or special character',
  })
  @MinLength(8)
  password: string;
}
```

## 3. Class Transformer Patterns

Use `class-transformer` to convert plain JavaScript objects into class instances, and to parse types properly (e.g., strings to numbers for query parameters).

```typescript
// src/users/dto/get-users-filter.dto.ts
import { IsOptional, IsString, IsInt, Min } from 'class-validator';
import { Type } from 'class-transformer';

export class GetUsersFilterDto {
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  search?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @Type(() => Number) // Transforms query param string '10' to number 10
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  limit?: number = 10;

  @IsOptional()
  @Type(() => Number)
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  page?: number = 1;
}
```

## 4. Partial DTOs for Updates

NestJS provides `@nestjs/mapped-types` (or `@nestjs/swagger` if using Swagger) to automatically generate update DTOs.

```typescript
// src/users/dto/update-user.dto.ts
import { PartialType } from '@nestjs/swagger'; // use @nestjs/mapped-types if not using Swagger
import { CreateUserDto } from './create-user.dto';

// Makes all properties of CreateUserDto optional
export class UpdateUserDto extends PartialType(CreateUserDto) {}
```

## 5. Nested Object Validation

To validate nested objects, use `@ValidateNested()` combined with `@Type()`.

```typescript
import { ValidateNested, IsDefined, IsString } from 'class-validator';
import { Type } from 'class-transformer';

class AddressDto {
  @IsString()
  street: string;
  @IsString()
  city: string;
}

export class CreateProfileDto {
  @IsDefined()
  @ValidateNested()
  @Type(() => AddressDto)
  address: AddressDto;
}
```

Siz `findUserMessages(chatId, user1Id)` funksiyasida token orqali kelgan `user1Id`ni olasiz — va shuni tekshirish kerakki, **shu user faqat o‘zi qatnashgan chatlardan xabarlarni ko‘ra olsin.**

### ✅ To‘g‘rilangan kod:
```ts
async findUserMessages(chatId: string, userId: string) {
  // 1. Chat mavjudligini tekshiramiz
  await checkExistsResurs<UserChat>(
    this.prisma,
    ModelsEnumInPrisma.USER_CHAT,
    'id',
    chatId
  );

  // 2. Shu foydalanuvchi ushbu chatning ishtirokchisi ekanligini tekshiramiz
  const chat = await this.prisma.userChat.findFirst({
    where: {
      id: chatId,
      OR: [
        { user1Id: userId },
        { user2Id: userId },
      ],
    },
  });

  if (!chat) {
    throw new ForbiddenException('Siz bu chatga kirish huquqiga ega emassiz');
  }

  // 3. Chatga tegishli barcha xabarlarni olish
  const messages = await this.prisma.messageUserChat.findMany({
    where: {
      chatId,
    },
    select: messageFindEntity,
    orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' }, // ixtiyoriy
  });

  return { messages: messages.map(messageReturnData) };
}
```

---

### 🧠 Nima o‘zgardi:
1. **`checkExistsResurs`** chatning o‘zi borligini tekshiradi.  
2. **`chat`** orqali tekshiramiz — `userId` shu chatda ishtirokchimi (`user1Id` yoki `user2Id` sifatida).

## 🧾 Xato tahlili

```
"message": "Request failed with status code 403"
```

Demak, **backend sizga `ForbiddenException`** (403) yuboryapti — ya’ni:  
> “Bu foydalanuvchining bu chatdagi xabarlarni ko‘rish huquqi yo‘q.”

---

## 💡 Ehtimoliy sabablar

Sizning backend funksiyangizda quyidagi shart bor:

```ts
const chat = await this.prisma.userChat.findFirst({
  where: {
    id: chatId,
    OR: [
      { user1Id: userId },
      { user2Id: userId },
    ],
  },
});
if (!chat) {
  throw new ForbiddenException('Siz bu chatga kirish huquqiga ega emassiz');
}
```

Demak, 403 chiqishining sababi quyidagilardan **biri** bo‘lishi mumkin:

1. `chatId` noto‘g‘ri — bu ID boshqa chatga tegishli.  
2. `userId` (token orqali kelayotgan foydalanuvchi ID) bu chatning **user1Id** yoki **user2Id** qatorida yo‘q.  
3. Token to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa ham, backenddagi `userId`ni olish joyida xato.  

---

## 🔍 Tekshirish yo‘li

### 1. Tokenni tekshirib ko‘ring
Backendda `JwtStrategy` yoki `AuthGuard` orqali foydalanuvchi ID `req.user.id` orqali olinadi.  
Shuni bir marta log qilib ko‘ring:

```ts
console.log('Auth User ID:', req.user.id);
```

Bu ID siz kutgan `user1Id` yoki `user2Id` bilan mos keladimi — tekshiring.

---

### 2. Chatdagi ishtirokchilarni tekshiring
`prisma studio` yoki `psql` orqali shu `chatId`ni ochib, kimlar qatnashganini tekshiring:

```sql
SELECT * FROM "UserChat" WHERE id = '75c40ae7-e8e0-4011-a304-8dcb9ec2249f';
```

`user1Id` va `user2Id` ustunlariga qarang.  
Token foydalanuvchi ID’si shu ikkaladan biriga to‘g‘rimi?

---

### 3. Frontendda `chatType`ni ham tekshiring
Sizda:
```ts
Messages.useAllMessages(chatType, chatId || "")
```

Lekin backendda `findUserMessages` **faqat `userChat`** uchun yozilgan.  
Agar `chatType` boshqa narsa (masalan `"group"` yoki `"channel"`) bo‘lsa,  
backend `userChat`ni topolmaydi va shu sababli **403** qaytaradi.

---

## ✅ Yechim

Agar sizda turli chat turlari (`user`, `group`, `channel`) bo‘lsa,
frontendda `chatType`ga qarab **turli endpoint**ni chaqiring:

```ts
if (chatType === "user") {
  Messages.useUserMessages(chatId)
} else if (chatType === "group") {
  Messages.useGroupMessages(chatId)
} else if (chatType === "channel") {
  Messages.useChannelMessages(chatId)
}
```

Yoki backendda `findMessages(chatType, chatId, userId)` degan **umumiy funksiya** yozing.

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Zo‘r 🎯 — ya’ni sizning maqsadingiz shuki:  
👉 agar `Messages.useAllMessages` dan **xato (403 yoki 404)** chiqsa, avtomatik ravishda **yangi chat yaratilsin**.  

Buni `useEffect` ichida juda toza tarzda qilish mumkin 👇

---

## ✅ To‘liq ishlaydigan yechim

```tsx
import React, { useEffect } from "react"
import { Messages, Chats } from "@/features" // Chats — createChat funksiyasi bo‘lsin

function Center({ chatType, chatId, targetUserId }) {
  const { data: ChatMessages, refetch, isLoading, isError, error } = Messages.useAllMessages(chatType, chatId || "")

  // Chat yaratish mutation
  const createChatMutation = Chats.useCreateChat()

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isError && error) {
      // Backend 403 yoki 404 qaytarsa — chat mavjud emas yoki kirish taqiqlangan
      const status = error?.response?.status

      if (status === 403 || status === 404) {
        console.warn("Chat topilmadi yoki ruxsat yo‘q — yangisini yaratamiz...")

        createChatMutation.mutate(
          {
            type: chatType, // 'user' | 'group' | 'channel'
            targetUserId,   // agar private chat bo‘lsa, kim bilan
          },
          {
            onSuccess: (newChat) => {
              console.log("✅ Chat yaratildi:", newChat)
              // Yangi chat id bilan xabarlarni qayta yuklash
              refetch()
            },
            onError: (err) => {
              console.error("❌ Chat yaratishda xato:", err)
            },
          }
        )
      }
    }
  }, [isError, error])

  return (
    <>
      {isLoading && <div>Yuklanmoqda...</div>}
      {!isLoading && ChatMessages && (
        <div>{ChatMessages.messages?.map((m) => <div key={m.id}>{m.text}</div>)}</div>
      )}
    </>
  )
}
```

---

## 🧠 Izoh

- `error?.response?.status` orqali backenddagi HTTP statusni olish mumkin.  
- Faqat `403` (forbidden) yoki `404` (not found) holatida chat yaratamiz.  
- `Chats.useCreateChat()` bu sizning `react-query` mutatsiya hook’ingiz bo‘lishi kerak (`mutationFn: createChatApi`).  
- Yaratilgandan keyin `refetch()` chaqirilib, yangi chatdagi xabarlar olinadi.  

---

Agar xohlasangiz, men sizga shu `Chats.useCreateChat()` hook’ni (`react-query` uchun) ham yozib beraman — `axios` bilan ishlaydigan, to‘liq ishlaydigan versiyada.  
Yozaymi?

Agar `findAllChats` ichida `userChat` topilmasa (ya’ni foydalanuvchi hali hech kim bilan yozishmagan bo‘lsa), backend avtomatik **yangi chat yaratib qo‘ysin**.

- `userChat` topilmasa (`userChats.length === 0`) →

- har biri bilan `userChat.create()` qilinadi.
