### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Yaxshi, bu logda **ikki xil muammo** ko‘rsatilgan 👇  

---

### 🧩 1. **React Hooks order xatosi**
> `React has detected a change in the order of Hooks called by Home.`  
> `Rendered more hooks than during the previous render.`

#### 🧠 Sabab:
Bu xato **React Hooks’lar (`useState`, `useEffect`, `useQuery` va boshqalar)** shart ichida yoki dinamik holda chaqirilganida yuz beradi.  
Masalan:

```tsx
if (selectedChat) {
  const { data } = useQuery(...)
}
```

yoki
```tsx
if (type === "user") useAllMessages();
else useAllChannels();
```

➡️ **Hooks** har bir renderda **bir xil tartibda** chaqirilishi kerak.  
Shartlar yoki sikllar ichida ishlatish qat’iyan mumkin emas.

#### ✅ Yechim:
Hook’larni doim **komponent boshida** chaqiring va shart ichida emas, balki **natijasini shart bilan ishlating**.

Masalan:
```tsx
const allMessages = useAllMessages();
const allChannels = useAllChannels();

const data = selectedType === "user" ? allMessages.data : allChannels.data;
```

Yoki:
```tsx
const query = useQuery(["messages"], () => fetchMessages(selectedChat?.id), {
  enabled: !!selectedChat,
});
```

---

### 🚫 2. **404 — Backend endpoint topilmadi**
> `POST http://127.0.0.1:15976/api/channel-subscriptions/create/ 404 (Not Found)`

#### 🧠 Sabab:
Frontend `createChannelSubscription()` funksiyasi orqali  
`POST /api/channel-subscriptions/create` so‘rov yubormoqda, lekin backend’da bu yo‘l **mavjud emas**.

#### ✅ Yechim:
NestJS backend’da shu endpoint’ni tekshiring.  
Masalan:

```ts
@Controller('channel-subscriptions')
export class ChannelSubscriptionsController {
  @Post('create')
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateChannelSubscriptionDto) {
    return this.service.create(dto);
  }
}
```

Agar siz `@Controller('api/channel-subscriptions')` deb yozmagan bo‘lsangiz,
Frontend’ning `baseURL` da `api/` bo‘lishi **kerak emas**.

---

### 🔍 Xulosa
| Muammo | Sabab | Yechim |
|--------|--------|--------|
| **Hooks order error** | Hook’lar if yoki for ichida chaqirilgan | Barchasini komponent boshida chaqirib, natijani shart bilan ishlat |
| **404 API not found** | Endpoint yo‘q yoki noto‘g‘ri URL | NestJS controller’ni tekshirish yoki frontend URL’ni to‘g‘rilash |

---

Agar xohlasangiz, sizga `Home` komponentingizdagi `useAllMessages` chaqirilgan joyni yuboring — men to‘g‘ri hook tartibiga keltirib beraman.

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Zo‘r 👌 — bu loglar shuni ko‘rsatmoqda: **backend’da kerakli endpointlar to‘g‘ri xaritalangan**, lekin frontend hozircha **noto‘g‘ri URL** yuboryapti.  

---

### 🔍 Backend’dagi mavjud endpointlar:
| Method | URL | Tavsif |
|--------|-----|--------|
| `POST` | `/api/channel-subscriptions/create/:chatId` | Yangi obuna yaratadi |
| `GET` | `/api/channel-subscriptions/my-subscriptions` | Foydalanuvchining obunalari |
| `GET` | `/api/channel-subscriptions/get-all/by-chatid/:id` | Chat bo‘yicha barcha obunalar |
| `DELETE` | `/api/channel-subscriptions/remove-one/by-subscriptionid/:id` | Obunani subscriptionId bo‘yicha o‘chirish |
| `DELETE` | `/api/channel-subscriptions/remove-one/by-subscriberid/:chatid` | Obunani chatId orqali o‘chirish |

---

### ⚠️ Frontendda esa quyidagicha noto‘g‘ri so‘rov ketmoqda:
```
POST http://127.0.0.1:15976/api/channel-subscriptions/create/
```
Bu URL’da `:chatId` **berilmagan**, shuning uchun **404 Not Found** chiqmoqda.

---

### ✅ To‘g‘rilangan so‘rov
Masalan, agar siz `chatId = "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"` bo‘lgan kanalda obuna yaratayotgan bo‘lsangiz:

```ts
await axios.post(`/api/channel-subscriptions/create/${chatId}`);
```

---

### 💡 Bonus: dinamik qilib yozish
Agar siz `chatId` ni `selectedChat.id` dan olayotgan bo‘lsangiz:
```ts
await axios.post(`/api/channel-subscriptions/create/${selectedChat?.id}`);
```

---

Agar siz `channel-subscriptions` uchun frontenddagi `service` yoki `hook` faylni ko‘rsatsangiz,  
men uni to‘g‘ri URL va typelarga to‘liq moslab, `axios` yoki `fetch` bilan REST formatda yozib beraman.

---

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Zo‘r — bu `Left` komponenti chatlar paneli uchun asosiy **chap panel** logikasini ko‘rsatmoqda, ya’ni “all”, “group”, “channel”, “user” turlari bo‘yicha chatlarni ko‘rsatish.  
Lekin `setChatTargets()` hozircha faqat `console.log()` bilan ishlayapti — endi uni backend’dagi `GET /api/chats/get-all` endpoint bilan to‘liq bog‘lab beramiz 👇

---

## ✅ To‘liq ishlaydigan versiya (`Left.tsx` yangilangan)
Quyidagi kod:
- Backend’dan `axios` orqali barcha chatlarni olib keladi.
- Ularni `chats` state’ga saqlaydi.
- Foydalanuvchi `targetFolder` ni o‘zgartirganda tegishli chat turlarini filtrlab beradi.
- UI’da har bir chat kartasini ko‘rsatish uchun tayyor holatda.

---

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useUserStore } from "@/store/user.store";
import { LeftProps } from "@/types/left/left.types";
import { Chat } from "@/types/ui/chat.types";
import api from "@/features/axiosInstance";

function Left({ props }: LeftProps) {
  const { user } = useUserStore();
  const [targetFolder, setTargetFolder] = useState<
    "all" | "group" | "channel" | "user"
  >("all");
  const [chats, setChats] = useState<Chat[]>([]);

  const targetFolders: ("all" | "group" | "channel" | "user")[] = [
    "all",
    "group",
    "channel",
    "user",
  ];

  // --- Chatlarni olish
  const setChatTargets = async () => {
    try {
      let url = "chats/get-all";
      if (targetFolder !== "all") url = `chats/get-all/${targetFolder}`;
      const { data } = await api.get(url);
      setChats(data);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("❌ Chatlarni olishda xato:", error);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    setChatTargets();
  }, [targetFolder]);

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full">
      {/* === Chap panel (filterlar) === */}
      <div className="w-1/6 border-r-2 min-h-screen flex flex-col">
        {targetFolders.map((target) => (
          <button
            key={target}
            onClick={() => setTargetFolder(target)}
            className={`py-2 px-3 text-left capitalize hover:bg-gray-100 ${
              targetFolder === target ? "bg-gray-200 font-bold" : ""
            }`}
          >
            {target}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* === O‘ng panel (chatlar ro‘yxati) === */}
      <div className="flex-1 p-3 overflow-y-auto">
        {chats.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-gray-500">Chatlar mavjud emas</p>
        ) : (
          chats.map((ch) => (
            <div
              key={ch.id}
              className="flex items-center gap-3 p-2 border-b hover:bg-gray-50 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <img
                src={ch.logo}
                alt={ch.title}
                className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover"
              />
              <div className="flex flex-col">
                <h2 className="font-semibold">{ch.title}</h2>
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 truncate">
                  {ch.description || "No description"}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default Left;
```

---

## 🔁 Backend’da bu ishlashi uchun kerak bo‘lgan endpointlar
`ChatsController` quyidagicha bo‘lishi kerak:

```ts
@Get('get-all')
findAllChats() {
  return this.chatsService.findAllChats();
}

@Get('get-all/:type')
findAllByType(@Param('type') type: 'user' | 'group' | 'channel') {
  return this.chatsService.findAllByType(type);
}
```

---

## 💡 Natija
- `targetFolder` → `all`, `group`, `channel`, yoki `user` bo‘lishi mumkin.  
- Har safar `targetFolder` o‘zgarsa, `api.get(chats/get-all/:type)` chaqiriladi.  
- UI real vaqt rejimida chatlarni o‘zgartirib ko‘rsatadi.  

---

Xohlaysizmi, men `Left` komponentiga **search (qidiruv)** va **real-time update (socket bilan)** qo‘shimcha qo‘shib beray?  
Shunda chatlar avtomatik yangilanadi, qayta yuklash shart bo‘lmaydi.

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Yaxshi — bu komponent (🧩 `Center`) logik jihatdan to‘g‘ri tuzilgan, lekin bir nechta **kichik xatolik va optimizatsiya joylari** bor. Quyida tahlil + tuzatilgan versiya keltiraman 👇

---

### 🧠 Asosiy muammolar

1. **File yuborishda `.map()` noto‘g‘ri ishlatilgan**  
   `files.map((files) => formMessageData.append("files",files[0]))` degan joyda `files[0]` noto‘g‘ri — `files` bu allaqachon `File` obyektning o‘zi.

   ✅ To‘g‘risi:
   ```ts
   files.forEach(file => formMessageData.append("files", file))
   ```

2. **`refetch()` faqat `chatId` yoki `chatType` o‘zgarganda emas, `sendMessage` muvaffaqiyatli bo‘lganda chaqirilishi kerak.**
   
   (Aks holda `useEffect` 2 marta ketma-ket ishga tushadi.)

3. **Bo‘sh fayl yoki text holati aniq if bilan tekshirilmagan.**

4. **RenderMessage** chaqiruvi faqat `ChatMessages?.messages` mavjud bo‘lsa emas, balki **yuklanayotgan** holatda ham indikator ko‘rsatish foydali bo‘ladi.

---

### ✅ Tuzatilgan va yaxshilangan versiya

```tsx
"use client"

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { Messages, Users } from "@/features"
import { createMessageSchema } from "@/features/messages/api/dto"
import { useUserStore } from "@/store/user.store"
import RenderMessage from "./center/RenderMesssage"
import * as UIState from "@/store/ui_store/store/index"

function Center() {
  const [text, setText] = useState("")
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>([])
  const [chatId, setChatId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [chatType, setChatType] = useState<"group" | "user" | "channel">("group")
  const { user } = useUserStore()
  const { selected } = UIState.useUIStore()

  const { data: ChatMessages, refetch, isLoading } = Messages.useAllMessages(chatType, chatId || "")

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selected.chat) {
      setChatId(selected.chat.id)
      setChatType(selected.chat.type as "group" | "user" | "channel")
      refetch()
    }
  }, [selected.chat])

  const handleSendMessage = async (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault()

    if (!user?.userId || !chatId) return console.error("User yoki chat aniqlanmagan")

    try {
      const validated = await createMessageSchema.validateAsync({
        text,
        chatId,
        senderId: user.userId,
      })

      // Fayl bor-yo‘qligini aniqlaymiz
      if (files.length > 0) {
        const formData = new FormData()
        files.forEach(file => formData.append("files", file))
        formData.append("senderId", user.userId)
        formData.append("chatId", chatId)

        await Messages.sendMessage(formData, chatType)
      } else if (text.trim()) {
        await Messages.sendMessage(validated, chatType)
      }

      setText("")
      setFiles([])
      await refetch()
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Xatolik:", err)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col w-full">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="header border-b-2 py-2 flex items-center gap-2">
        {selected.chat ? (
          <>
            <img
              src={selected.chat.logo || ""}
              alt="chat-logo"
              className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full object-cover"
            />
            <div>
              <h1 className="font-semibold">{selected.chat.title}</h1>
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <h1 className="text-gray-400">Chat tanlang</h1>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Messages */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">
        {isLoading ? (
          <p className="text-gray-400 text-center">Yuklanmoqda...</p>
        ) : ChatMessages?.messages?.length ? (
          <RenderMessage messages={ChatMessages.messages} refetch={refetch} />
        ) : (
          <p className="text-gray-400 text-center">Xabarlar yo‘q</p>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Input */}
      <form onSubmit={handleSendMessage} className="p-3 flex gap-2 border-t bg-white">
        <input
          type="file"
          name="files"
          multiple
          onChange={(e) => setFiles(Array.from(e.target.files || []))}
          className="hidden"
          id="file-upload"
        />
        <label htmlFor="file-upload" className="cursor-pointer px-3 py-2 bg-gray-200 rounded">
          📎
        </label>

        <input
          type="text"
          value={text}
          onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Xabar yozing..."
          className="flex-1 border px-3 py-2 rounded"
        />

        <button
          type="submit"
          className="bg-blue-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded hover:bg-blue-600"
          disabled={!text.trim() && files.length === 0}
        >
          Yuborish
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  )
}

export default Center
```

---

### 🔍 Asosiy yaxshilanishlar:
| Nima | Nima uchun foydali |
|------|---------------------|
| `forEach` bilan fayl yuborish | `.map()` dan to‘g‘riroq va tozalaydi |
| `disabled` tugma | Xabar yoki fayl yo‘q bo‘lsa yuborish to‘xtaydi |
| `isLoading` ko‘rsatkich | UX yaxshilanadi |
| `await refetch()` | Har bir yuborishdan keyin chat yangilanadi |
| `selected.chat` bilan sinxronizatsiya | Chat o‘zgarganda avtomatik yangilanadi |

---

Xohlaysizmi men shunga socket.io qo‘shib, yangi xabarlar real vaqt rejimida (refetchsiz) chiqadigan qilib beray?

---


## Manba: `zdes_archive_docs/raw_history/skills/angular-http-typed-services.md`

# Angular Typed HTTP Services and Error Handling

This document covers best practices for connecting an Angular frontend to a REST API, focusing on strong typing and centralized HTTP calls.

## 1. Type Definitions (Interfaces/Models)

Always define TypeScript interfaces for API requests (Payloads) and responses (DTOs). These should match the backend contracts exactly.

```typescript
// src/app/core/models/user.model.ts
export interface User {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

export interface CreateUserPayload {
  email: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
}

export interface PaginatedResponse<T> {
  data: T[];
  meta: {
    total: number;
    page: number;
  };
}
```

## 2. Environment Configuration

Store API base URLs in environment variables.

```typescript
// src/environments/environment.ts
export const environment = {
  production: false,
  apiUrl: 'http://localhost:3000/api/v1'
};
```

## 3. Service Pattern

Create dedicated services for each domain entity (e.g., `UserService`). Use generics with `HttpClient`.

```typescript
// src/app/core/services/user.service.ts
import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { environment } from '../../../environments/environment';
import { User, CreateUserPayload, PaginatedResponse } from '../models/user.model';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class UserService {
  private http = inject(HttpClient);
  private apiUrl = `${environment.apiUrl}/users`;

  getUsers(page = 1, limit = 10): Observable<PaginatedResponse<User>> {
    const params = new HttpParams()
      .set('page', page.toString())
      .set('limit', limit.toString());

    return this.http.get<PaginatedResponse<User>>(this.apiUrl, { params });
  }

  getUser(id: string): Observable<User> {
    return this.http.get<User>(`${this.apiUrl}/${id}`);
  }

  createUser(payload: CreateUserPayload): Observable<User> {
    return this.http.post<User>(this.apiUrl, payload);
  }

  updateUser(id: string, payload: Partial<CreateUserPayload>): Observable<User> {
    return this.http.patch<User>(`${this.apiUrl}/${id}`, payload);
  }

  deleteUser(id: string): Observable<void> {
    return this.http.delete<void>(`${this.apiUrl}/${id}`);
  }
}
```

## 4. Error Handling via Interceptors

Rather than catching errors in every component, use an `HttpInterceptor` to handle global errors (like displaying toasts/snackbars on 500 or redirecting on 401).

```typescript
// src/app/core/interceptors/error.interceptor.ts
import { HttpInterceptorFn, HttpErrorResponse } from '@angular/common/http';
import { inject } from '@angular/core';
import { catchError, throwError } from 'rxjs';
import { ToastrService } from 'ngx-toastr'; // Example notification service

export const errorInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (req, next) => {
  const toastr = inject(ToastrService);

  return next(req).pipe(
    catchError((error: HttpErrorResponse) => {
      let errorMessage = 'An unknown error occurred';

      if (error.error instanceof ErrorEvent) {
        // Client-side error
        errorMessage = error.error.message;
      } else {
        // Server-side error
        if (error.status === 400 && error.error.message) {
          // Handle NestJS validation errors (often arrays)
          errorMessage = Array.isArray(error.error.message) 
            ? error.error.message.join(', ') 
            : error.error.message;
        } else if (error.status === 401) {
          errorMessage = 'Unauthorized access';
          // Trigger logout logic here
        } else if (error.status >= 500) {
          errorMessage = 'Server error occurred';
        }
      }

      toastr.error(errorMessage, `Error ${error.status}`);
      return throwError(() => error);
    })
  );
};
```

## 5. Registering Interceptors (Standalone Components)

```typescript
// src/app/app.config.ts
import { ApplicationConfig } from '@angular/core';
import { provideHttpClient, withInterceptors } from '@angular/common/http';
import { errorInterceptor } from './core/interceptors/error.interceptor';

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideHttpClient(
      withInterceptors([errorInterceptor])
    )
  ]
};
```

# AI Conversation Memory Extractor v2.0

## ROLE

You are an AI Conversation Memory Extractor.

Your task is to analyze the CURRENT conversation only and produce a structured memory object.

---

## OBJECTIVES

1. Extract factual user information.
2. Separate facts from AI suggestions.
3. Record decisions.
4. Record ideas.
5. Record learning topics.
6. Record future tasks.
7. Create concise summaries.
8. Never hallucinate.
9. Never infer missing information.
10. Return ONLY valid JSON.

---

## STRICT RULES

- Use ONLY information explicitly stated in the current conversation.
- Never guess.
- Never infer.
- Never use previous conversations.
- Never explain your output.
- Never wrap JSON inside markdown.
- Return ONLY valid JSON.

If information is unavailable:

- use ""
- or []

Never fabricate values.

---

## OUTPUT SCHEMA

{
  "meta": {
    "title": "",
    "date": "",
    "language": "",
    "ai": "",
    "version": "2.0"
  },

  "user_context": {
    "facts": [],
    "preferences": [],
    "goals": [],
    "projects": [],
    "skills": [],
    "constraints": []
  },

  "assistant_summary": {
    "recommendations": [],
    "explanations": [],
    "examples": []
  },

  "conversation_context": "",

  "conversation_summary": "",

  "new_user_information": [],

  "decisions": [],

  "ideas": [],

  "learning_topics": [],

  "parking_lot": [],

  "todos": [],

  "entities": [],

  "keywords": [],

  "messages": {
    "user_count": 0,
    "assistant_count": 0
  }
}

---

## FIELD DEFINITIONS

### meta

title
Short conversation title.

date
Conversation date if available.

language
Primary language.

ai
Assistant name.

version
Prompt version.

---

### user_context

facts
Explicit facts about the user.

preferences
Explicit likes/dislikes.

goals
Explicit goals.

projects
Projects currently discussed.

skills
Skills explicitly mentioned.

constraints
Explicit limitations.

---

### assistant_summary

recommendations
Advice given by the assistant.

explanations
Concepts explained.

examples
Examples shown.

---

### conversation_context

One sentence describing the overall topic.

---

### conversation_summary

3–6 sentence concise summary.

---

### new_user_information

Only NEW information introduced by the user.

---

### decisions

Explicit decisions made.

Example:

[
  "User decided to learn PHP."
]

---

### ideas

Ideas proposed during conversation.

---

### learning_topics

Subjects studied.

Example:

[
  "PHP",
  "Laravel"
]

---

### parking_lot

Ideas intentionally postponed.

---

### todos

Action items.

---

### entities

Named entities.

Examples:

[
  "PHP",
  "Laravel",
  "MySQL"
]

---

### keywords

Searchable keywords.

---

### messages

Conversation statistics.

---

## EXTRACTION PRIORITY

Priority order:

1. User facts
2. User goals
3. Decisions
4. Todos
5. Learning topics
6. Ideas
7. Assistant recommendations
8. Keywords

---

## QUALITY RULES

Remove duplicates.

Keep wording concise.

Do not repeat the same information in multiple fields unless necessary.

Preserve chronological order when possible.

---

## VALIDATION

Before returning:

✓ JSON is valid.

✓ No markdown.

✓ No comments.

✓ No explanations.

✓ Arrays contain only extracted items.

✓ Unknown values are "" or [].

✓ No hallucinations.

---

## OUTPUT

Return ONLY the JSON object.


## Manba: `zdes_archive_docs/raw_history/skills/nestjs-rest-api-contracts.md`

# NestJS REST API Contracts: Controllers, DTOs, and Response Shapes

This document outlines the best practices for designing REST APIs in NestJS, focusing on clear contracts between the backend and frontend.

## 1. Controller Design

Controllers should be lean. Their primary responsibility is to receive requests, validate input via DTOs, pass the work to a service, and return a formatted response.

### Example: Users Controller

```typescript
import { Controller, Get, Post, Body, Param, Put, Delete, HttpCode, HttpStatus } from '@nestjs/common';
import { UsersService } from './users.service';
import { CreateUserDto } from './dto/create-user.dto';
import { UpdateUserDto } from './dto/update-user.dto';
import { UserResponseDto } from './dto/user-response.dto';
import { ApiTags, ApiOperation, ApiResponse } from '@nestjs/swagger';

@ApiTags('Users')
@Controller({ path: 'users', version: '1' }) // API Versioning is recommended
export class UsersController {
  constructor(private readonly usersService: UsersService) {}

  @Post()
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new user' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'User created successfully', type: UserResponseDto })
  async create(@Body() createUserDto: CreateUserDto): Promise<UserResponseDto> {
    const user = await this.usersService.create(createUserDto);
    return new UserResponseDto(user);
  }

  @Get()
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get all users' })
  async findAll(): Promise<UserResponseDto[]> {
    const users = await this.usersService.findAll();
    return users.map(user => new UserResponseDto(user));
  }

  @Get(':id')
  async findOne(@Param('id') id: string): Promise<UserResponseDto> {
    const user = await this.usersService.findOne(id);
    return new UserResponseDto(user);
  }
}
```

## 2. Response Shape Consistency

For a REST API to be easily consumable by an Angular frontend, response shapes must be predictable. Avoid returning raw Prisma models directly from controllers, as they might contain sensitive fields (like passwords).

### Pattern A: Standard Wrapper

Wrap responses in a standard object (e.g., `{ data: T, meta?: any }`). This is useful for pagination.

```typescript
export interface PaginatedResponse<T> {
  data: T[];
  meta: {
    total: number;
    page: number;
    lastPage: number;
  };
}
```

NestJS Interceptors can automate this:

```typescript
import { Injectable, NestInterceptor, ExecutionContext, CallHandler } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { map } from 'rxjs/operators';

export interface Response<T> {
  data: T;
}

@Injectable()
export class TransformInterceptor<T> implements NestInterceptor<T, Response<T>> {
  intercept(context: ExecutionContext, next: CallHandler): Observable<Response<T>> {
    return next.handle().pipe(map(data => ({ data })));
  }
}
```

### Pattern B: DTO Transformation

Use `ClassSerializerInterceptor` to strip sensitive data automatically.

```typescript
// main.ts
import { ClassSerializerInterceptor, ValidationPipe } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';

async function bootstrap() {
  const app = await NestFactory.create(AppModule);
  // Use global interceptor for serialization
  app.useGlobalInterceptors(new ClassSerializerInterceptor(app.get(Reflector)));
  await app.listen(3000);
}
```

## 3. Best Practices Summary

- **Never return raw database models**: Always map models to Response DTOs.
- **Use standard HTTP Status Codes**: 200 for OK, 201 for Created, 204 for No Content, 400 for Bad Request, 404 for Not Found.
- **Version your APIs**: Use URI versioning (e.g., `/v1/users`).
- **Use Swagger (OpenAPI)**: Documenting controllers and DTOs with `@nestjs/swagger` decorators generates a live API contract that the frontend team can rely on.

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Sizning JSDoc typing'ingizda bir nechta xatolar bor:

1. `Meesage` va `Message` aralashib ketgan.
2. `@typedef {Message[],(action) => Meesage[]}` noto'g'ri sintaksis.
3. `useMessages` aslida `{ state, dispatch }` obyektini qaytaradi.

To'g'ri usul quyidagicha bo'ladi.

```js
/**
 * @typedef {Object} Message
 * @property {string} id
 * @property {string} message
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} Action
 * @property {"create" | "all"} type
 * @property {Message | Message[]} payload
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} MessagesContext
 * @property {Message[]} state
 * @property {(action: Action) => void} dispatch
 */

/**
 * @returns {MessagesContext}
 */
export function useMessages() {
    const context = useContext(messagesContext);

    return context;
}
```

## Yoki React tipini ham qo'shmoqchi bo'lsangiz

`dispatch` oddiy funksiya emas, u `React.Dispatch<Action>` hisoblanadi.

```js
/**
 * @typedef {import("react").Dispatch<Action>} Dispatch
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} MessagesContext
 * @property {Message[]} state
 * @property {Dispatch} dispatch
 */

/**
 * @returns {MessagesContext}
 */
export function useMessages() {
    return useContext(messagesContext);
}
```

```js
/**

 */

/** @type {import("react").Context<MessagesContext>} */
const messagesContext = createContext(
    /** @type {MessagesContext} */ ({
        state: [],
```

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Sizning kodingizda bir nechta muammo bor.

### 1. `useRef` noto'g'ri ishlatilgan

Hozir:

```jsx
const form = useRef();

const data = new FormData(form);
```

`form` bu ref obyekti. DOM element emas.

To'g'risi:

```jsx
const form = useRef(null);

function sign() {
    const data = new FormData(form.current);

    console.log(Object.fromEntries(data));
}
```

yoki umuman `event.currentTarget` ishlatish mumkin.

---

### 2. Button `type="button"`

Siz `action` va `method` yozgansiz:

```jsx
<form action="http://localhost:3000/sign" method="post">
```

Lekin button

```jsx
<button type="button">
```

bo'lgani uchun form **hech qachon submit bo'lmaydi**.

Agar browser yuborsin desangiz

```jsx
<button type="submit">
```

bo'lishi kerak.

Agar fetch bilan yubormoqchi bo'lsangiz

```jsx
<form ref={form} onSubmit={sign}>
```

va

```jsx
function sign(e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    const data = new FormData(form.current);
}
```

---

### 3. `socket.off` xato

Siz

```jsx
socket.on("hello", ...)
socket.off("heelo", ...)
```

deb yozgansiz.

`hello` va `heelo` boshqa-boshqa event.

Bundan tashqari `off` ni cleanup ichida chaqirish kerak.

```jsx
useEffect(() => {
    function onHello(data) {
        console.log(data);
    }

    socket.on("hello", onHello);

    return () => {
        socket.off("hello", onHello);
    };
}, []);
```

---

### 4. `FormData` ni ko'rish

`console.log(data)` deyarli foydali ma'lumot bermaydi.

Yaxshisi

```jsx
const formData = new FormData(form.current);

console.log(Object.fromEntries(formData));
```

Natija:

```js
{
    login: "admin",
    parol: "123456"
}
```

---

### 5. `sessionStorage.getItem`

Hozir

```jsx
const user = sessionStorage.getItem("user");
```

Bu komponent har render bo'lganda o'qiladi.

Agar login qilgandan keyin

```js
sessionStorage.setItem("user", "...");
```

qilsangiz, App qayta render bo'lmaydi.

Buni `useState` bilan boshqarish yoki Context orqali saqlash tavsiya etiladi.

---

Umuman olganda, login formangizni React usulida quyidagicha yozish tavsiya etiladi:

```jsx
const form = useRef(null);

function sign(e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    const data = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form.current));

    console.log(data);

    // fetch yoki axios orqali backendga yuborasiz
}

return (
    <form ref={form} onSubmit={sign}>
        <input name="login" placeholder="Login" />
        <input type="password" name="parol" placeholder="Parol" />
        <button type="submit">Submit</button>
    </form>
);
```

Bu React'da eng ko'p qo'llaniladigan va tavsiya etiladigan usuldir.

---

Anchadan beri kod yozmagan edim fo'rmaga qaytish uchun mini kodlar bilan ishlayabdman bu loyiha emas fetch qanday yozilardi faqat so'ragan narsamni ayt

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Aslida `setUser(res)` **render qiladi**. Muammo boshqa joyda.

### 1. URL noto'g'ri yozilgan

Sizda:

```js
fetch("[http://localhost:3000/sign](http://localhost:3000/sign)", {
```

Bu Markdown linki bo'lib qolgan.

To'g'risi:

```js
fetch("http://localhost:3000/sign", {
```

---

### 2. `onSubmit` va `onClick` ikkalasi ham `sign` ni chaqiryapti

```jsx
<form onSubmit={sign}>
```

bo'lsa, bu yetarli.

Button:

```jsx
<button type="submit">Submit</button>
```

`onClick={sign}` ni olib tashlang.

---

### 3. `useEffect` noto'g'ri

Siz darhol `off` ni chaqiryapsiz.

```js
useEffect(() => {
    socket.on("hello", ...);

    socket.off("hello", ...); // shu zahoti o'chirib yuboryapti
}, [user]);
```

To'g'risi:

```js
useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (data) => console.log(data);

    socket.on("hello", handler);

    return () => {
        socket.off("hello", handler);
    };
}, []);
```

---

### 4. `res` ni tekshiring

Agar

```js
console.log(res);
```

chiqayotgan bo'lsa va

```js
setUser(res);
```

dan keyin ham login sahifasi tursa, demak `res` `null` yoki `undefined`.

Masalan:

```js
.then(async (response) => {
    const res = await response.json();

    console.log(res); // shu nima chiqyapti?
    setUser(res);
})
```

Shuni tekshiring.

---

### 5. `useState`

Bu qismi ishlaydi:

```js
const [user, setUser] = useState(
    JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem("user"))
);
```

`setUser(res)` chaqirilishi bilan komponent qayta render bo'lishi kerak.

Agar bo'lmayotgan bo'lsa, deyarli aniq sabab:
- `fetch` xato bo'lyapti;
- yoki `response.json()` siz kutgan obyektni qaytarmayapti.

**Savol:** `console.log(res)` da aynan nima chiqyapti? (`null`, `{}`, `"ok"` yoki boshqa narsa?)

Xatolik `setUser` da emas. React xabarining o'zi sababni aytyapti:

> **Rendered more hooks than during the previous render.**

Siz `useEffect` ni **shartli ravishda** chaqiryapsiz.

Hozirgi kodingizning tuzilishi taxminan shunday:

```jsx
const form = useRef();
const [user, setUser] = useState(...);

if (!user) {
    return (
        // login page
    );
}

useEffect(() => {
    ...
}, []);
```

### Birinchi render

`user = null`

React bajaradi:

```
✅ useRef
✅ useState
⛔ return
```

`useEffect` ga umuman yetib bormaydi.

---

### Ikkinchi render

`user` endi mavjud.

React bajaradi:

```
✅ useRef
✅ useState
✅ useEffect
```

Oldingi renderda **2 ta hook**, keyingisida **3 ta hook** bo'lib qoldi.

React bunga ruxsat bermaydi.

---

## To'g'risi

Barcha hooklar **har doim bir xil tartibda** chaqirilishi kerak.

```jsx
const form = useRef();
const [user, setUser] = useState(...);

useEffect(() => {
    ...
}, []);

if (!user) {
    return (
        // login page
    );
}

return (
    // chat page
);
```

yoki `useEffect` ichida `user` ni tekshirasiz:

```jsx
useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;

    // socket logikasi
}, [user]);
```

---

### React'ning eng muhim qoidalaridan biri

❌ Bunday mumkin emas:

```jsx
if (condition) {
    useEffect(...);
}
```

❌

```jsx
if (condition) {
    return ...
}

useEffect(...);
```

Agar `condition` o'zgaradigan bo'lsa.

✅ Har doim:

```jsx
useEffect(...);

if (condition) {
    return ...
```

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

### 1. `if (user) return` teskari yozilgan

Siz socketni **login bo'lgandan keyin** ulamoqchisiz.

Hozir esa:

```js
useEffect(() => {
    if (user) return;

    socket.on("hello", ...)
}, []);
```

Bu `user` bo'lsa effectdan chiqib ketadi, ya'ni socket **ulanmaydi**.

To'g'risi:

```js
useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;

    function onHello(data) {
        console.log(data);
    }

    socket.on("hello", onHello);

    return () => {
        socket.off("hello", onHello);
    };
}, [user]);
```

`[user]` bo'lishi kerak, chunki login bo'lgandan keyin effect qayta ishlashi kerak.

---

### 2. `socket.off` noto'g'ri

Siz:

```js
socket.on("hello", (data) => {
    console.log(data);
});

return () =>
    socket.off("hello", () => {
        console.log("hello event off");
    });
```

`on` va `off` ga **bir xil funksiya** berilishi kerak.

To'g'risi:

```js
function onHello(data) {
    console.log(data);
}

socket.on("hello", onHello);

return () => {
    socket.off("hello", onHello);
};
```

---

Sizda hali ham:

```js
fetch("[http://localhost:3000/sign](http://localhost:3000/sign)", ...)
```

bo'lib turibdi.

To'g'risi:

```js
fetch("http://localhost:3000/sign", ...)
```

---

Qolgan qismi to'g'ri. Hooklar xatoligi ham bartaraf bo'lgan.

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Agar backend `crypto.randomUUID()` ishlatayotgan bo'lsa, **`key` muammosi bo'lmasligi kerak**. Demak muammo boshqa joyda.

Tekshirish kerak bo'lgan narsalar:

### 1. React qanday xato beryapti?

Aniq matni muhim.

Masalan:

```text
Warning: Encountered two children with the same key
```

yoki

```text
Each child in a list should have a unique "key" prop.
```

Bu ikkalasi boshqa-boshqa muammo.

---

### 2. ID larni tekshiring

`map` qilishdan oldin:

```js
console.log(messagesState.map(m => m.id));
```

Agar quyidagiga o'xshash chiqsa:

```js
[
  "1",
  "2",
  "2",
  "3"
]
```

demak server yoki reducer bir xil xabarni ikki marta qo'shyapti.

---

### 3. Men eng ko'p gumon qilayotgan joy

Siz `socket.on` larni cleanup qilmayapsiz.

Hozir:

```js
useEffect(() => {
    socket.on("newMessage", ...);

    socket.off("newMessage", () => {});
}, []);
```

Bu ishlamaydi.

Chunki `off` ga boshqa funksiya berilyapti.

Natijada komponent qayta mount bo'lsa:

```
on(newMessage)
on(newMessage)
on(newMessage)
```

bo'lib ketadi.

Bitta message keladi, reducer esa 3 marta ishlaydi.

---

To'g'risi:

```js
useEffect(() => {
    function handleNewMessage(data) {
        setMessages({ type: "create", payload: data });
    }

    function handleAll(messages) {
        setMessages({ type: "all", payload: messages });
    }

    socket.on("newMessage", handleNewMessage);
    socket.on("all", handleAll);

    return () => {
        socket.off("newMessage", handleNewMessage);
        socket.off("all", handleAll);
    };
}, []);
```

---

### 4. Reducer ham tekshirib ko'ring

Temporary:

```js
case "create":
    console.log(action.payload.id);
    return [...state, action.payload];
```

Agar bir xil ID ikki marta log bo'lsa, server yoki socket event ikki marta kelmoqda.

---

## Mening taxminim

`crypto.randomUUID()` muammo emas.

Ko'proq ehtimol:

- `newMessage` eventi bir necha marta subscribe bo'lyapti;
- yoki server bir xil message'ni ikki marta emit qilyapti.

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Bu logga qarab muammo **React'da emas**, state'ingizda **bir xil `id` li message ikki marta bor**.

Men quyidagi ketma-ketlikni tekshirgan bo'lardim.

### 1. State ichida haqiqatan ham duplicate bormi?

`return` dan oldin:

```js
console.table(messagesState.map(m => ({
    id: m.id,
    message: m.message
})));
```

Agar bir xil `id` ikki marta chiqsa, React to'g'ri ogohlantiryapti.

---

### 2. `create` reducerini tekshiring

Hozircha vaqtincha shunday yozing:

```js
case "create":
    console.log("create:", action.payload.id);

    return [...state, {
        ...action.payload,
        isOwn: action.payload.ownerId === user.id
    }];
```

Agar bitta xabar yuborganingizda

```
create: e296...
create: e296...
```

ikki marta chiqsa, `newMessage` eventi ikki marta kelmoqda.

---

### 3. Men eng ko'p gumon qilayotgan joy

Siz avval ham `socket.off` ni noto'g'ri ishlatayotgan edingiz.

Masalan:

```js
socket.on("newMessage", (data) => {
    ...
});

socket.off("newMessage", () => {});
```

Bu **hech narsani o'chirmaydi**.

To'g'risi:

```js
useEffect(() => {
    function handleNewMessage(data) {
        setMessages({
            type: "create",
            payload: data
        });
    }

    socket.on("newMessage", handleNewMessage);

    return () => {
        socket.off("newMessage", handleNewMessage);
    };
}, []);
```

---

### 4. Yoki server ikki marta emit qilyaptimi?

Serverdagi kodni ham tekshiring.

Masalan:

```js
io.emit("newMessage", message);
```

faqat **bir marta** ishlashi kerak.

Ba'zida quyidagicha bo'lib qoladi:

```js
socket.on("sendMessage", () => {
    io.emit("newMessage", message);
});

socket.on("sendMessage", () => {
    io.emit("newMessage", message);
});
```

yoki middleware sababli ikki marta ishlaydi.

---

## Menga eng kerakli kod

Agar shu ikkitasini yuborsangiz, qayerda duplicate bo'layotganini aniq aytaman:

1. **InputArea.jsx** (`socket.emit("sendMessage", ...)` qiladigan joy)
2. **Backenddagi** `socket.on("sendMessage", ...)` qismi.

Logga qaraganda muammo deyarli aniq **React `key`da emas**, balki **bir xil message state'ga ikki marta qo'shilayotganida**.

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

```
@SubscribeMessage("newMessage")
createMessage(client: Socket, data: { message: string,user : User }) {
    console.log(data)
    const messageId = crypto.randomUUID()
    const message = {
        id: messageId,
        message: data.message,
        ownerId : data?.user?.id || ""
    }
    messages.push(message)

    client.broadcast.emit("newMessage",{...message,isOwn:false})
    client.emit("newMessage",{...message,isOwn : true})
}
```

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Backend kodingizga qarasam, `crypto.randomUUID()` bilan bog'liq muammo ko'rinmayapti.

Lekin mana bu joy e'tiborimni tortdi:

```ts
client.broadcast.emit("newMessage", {
    ...message,
    isOwn: false,
});

client.emit("newMessage", {
    ...message,
    isOwn: true,
});
```

Bu kodning o'zi **bir xil clientga ikki marta yubormaydi**:

- `client.emit` → faqat yuborgan userga.
- `client.broadcast.emit` → qolgan barcha userlarga.

Demak backend tomoni to'g'ri ko'rinyapti.

---

## Endi men 99% frontenddan shubhalanyapman

Siz `Chat.jsx` da shunga o'xshash narsa qilgansiz:

```js
useEffect(() => {
    socket.on("newMessage", ...);
    socket.on("all", ...);
}, []);
```

Lekin cleanup yo'q yoki noto'g'ri.

Agar Vite Hot Reload (HMR) ishlayotgan bo'lsa, har safar faylni saqlaganingizda:

```
old listener
new listener
new listener
new listener
```

bo'lib qoladi.

Logingizda ham:

```
[vite] hot updated: /src/components/Chat.jsx
```

degan satrlar bor. Bu HMR ishlayotganini bildiradi.

---

## Hozir tekshirib ko'ring

`newMessage` listener ichiga qo'ying:

```js
socket.on("newMessage", (data) => {
    console.count("newMessage");
    console.log(data);

    setMessages({
        type: "create",
        payload: data,
    });
});
```

Bitta message yuboring.

Agar:

```
newMessage: 1
newMessage: 2
```

chiqsa, listener ikki marta ulangan.

---

## Yana bitta ehtimol

`MessagesProvider` ikki marta render qilinayotgan bo'lishi ham mumkin.

`main.jsx` ni ham ko'rsating.

Masalan:

```jsx
<React.StrictMode>
    <MessagesProvider>
        <App />
    </MessagesProvider>
</React.StrictMode>
```

`StrictMode` developmentda ba'zi lifecycle'larni ikki marta ishga tushiradi, lekin **eventning ikki marta kelishiga sabab bo'lmasligi kerak**. Shunga qaramay, `main.jsx` ni ko'rish foydali bo'ladi.

---

### Menga yana ikkita fayl kerak:

1. `Chat.jsx` ning **to'liq** kodi (hozirgi holati).
2. `main.jsx`.

Shunda muammo qayerdaligini aniq ko'rsatib beraman. Hozircha backenddagi `crypto.randomUUID()` yoki `emit` lar noto'g'ri ko'rinmayapti.

---

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Muammo topildi. `socket.off()` ni noto'g'ri ishlatyapsiz.

Siz `on()` ga **bir funksiya**, `off()` ga esa **boshqa yangi funksiya** beryapsiz.

Hozir:

```js
socket.on("newMessage", (data) => {
  console.log(data)
  setMessages({ type: "create", payload: data })
})

return () => {
  socket.off("newMessage", (args) => {})
}
```

Bu ishlamaydi. Chunki:

```js
(data) => { ... }
```

va

```js
(args) => {}
```

ikki xil funksiya obyektlari.

Socket.IO faqat **o'sha bir xil funksiya**ni o'chira oladi.

---

## To'g'ri yozilishi

```js
useEffect(() => {
    function handleAll(messages) {
        setMessages({
            type: "all",
            payload: messages,
        });
    }

    function handleNewMessage(data) {
        console.log(data);

        setMessages({
            type: "create",
            payload: data,
        });
    }

    socket.on("all", handleAll);
    socket.on("newMessage", handleNewMessage);

    return () => {
        socket.off("all", handleAll);
        socket.off("newMessage", handleNewMessage);
    };
}, []);
```

---

## Lekin...

Sizning loglaringizni yana bir marta ko'rib chiqdim va yana bir ehtimol bor.

Siz `MessagesProvider` ichida reducerda:

```js
case "create":
    return [...state, ...]
```

qilyapsiz.

Agar:

1. `"all"` eventida shu message kelgan bo'lsa,
2. keyin `"newMessage"` eventida **o'sha message yana** kelgan bo'lsa,

state quyidagicha bo'ladi:

```js
[
  { id: "123" },
  { id: "456" },
  { id: "789" }, // all
  { id: "789" }, // newMessage
]
```

React aynan shunda:

> Encountered two children with the same key

deydi.

---

## Shuni tekshirib ko'ring

Reducerda vaqtincha:

```js
case "create":
    if (state.some(m => m.id === action.payload.id)) {
        console.log("Duplicate:", action.payload.id);
        return state;
    }

    return [
        ...state,
        {
            ...action.payload,
            isOwn: action.payload.ownerId === user.id,
        },
    ];
```

Agar konsolda:

```text
Duplicate: e296b8df-...
```

chiqsa, demak muammo aniq topilgan.

---

### Men hozir 80% shundan shubhalanyapman:

- `all` event tarixni yuboryapti.
- `newMessage` esa shu tarixdagi message'ni yana qo'shyapti.

Shu sababli bir xil `id` state ichiga ikki marta tushyapti.

**Savol:** `"all"` event qachon yuboriladi? Faqat socket ulanganida (`connection` paytida)mi yoki har yangi message yozilganda ham yuboriladimi?

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

Nega function off ga ham on ga ham bitta bo'lishi kerak bu WebSocketda  socket.on = () =>{} ga bog'liqmi

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Ha, aynan shunga bog'liq. Bu Socket.IO emas, umuman JavaScript'dagi **function reference (obyekt identifikatori)** tushunchasi.

Masalan:

```js
function a() {}

const b = a;

console.log(a === b); // true
```

Lekin:

```js
() => {}
() => {}
```

ikkalasi bir xil ko'rinsa ham:

```js
console.log((() => {}) === (() => {})); // false
```

Chunki har safar yangi funksiya yaratiladi.

---

Socket.IO ichida soddalashtirib aytganda shunga o'xshash narsa bo'ladi:

```js
const listeners = {
    newMessage: []
};

socket.on("newMessage", fn);
```

`on` ishlaganda:

```js
listeners.newMessage.push(fn);
```

bo'ladi.

Masalan:

```js
const fn = (data) => console.log(data);

socket.on("newMessage", fn);
```

Natija:

```js
listeners.newMessage = [
    fn
];
```

Keyin:

```js
socket.off("newMessage", fn);
```

Socket ichida taxminan:

```js
listeners.newMessage =
    listeners.newMessage.filter(item => item !== fn);
```

`fn === fn` bo'lgani uchun o'chadi.

---

Ammo sizning holatingiz:

```js
socket.on("newMessage", (data) => {
    console.log(data);
});
```

va keyin:

```js
socket.off("newMessage", (data) => {
    console.log(data);
});
```

Bu ikkita **mutlaqo boshqa obyekt**.

Tasavvur qiling:

```js
const f1 = (data) => console.log(data);
const f2 = (data) => console.log(data);

console.log(f1 === f2); // false
```

Socket ichida esa:

```js
listeners = [
    f1
];
```

Siz esa:

```js
off(f2);
```

qilyapsiz.

Socket `f2` ni qidiradi, lekin ro'yxatda faqat `f1` bor.

Shuning uchun hech narsani o'chirmaydi.

---

Shuning uchun React'da odatda shunday yoziladi:

```js
useEffect(() => {
    function handleMessage(data) {
        console.log(data);
    }

    socket.on("newMessage", handleMessage);

    return () => {
        socket.off("newMessage", handleMessage);
    };
}, []);
```

Bu yerda `handleMessage` **bir xil function reference** bo'lib qoladi.

---

Qiziq tomoni shundaki, Socket.IO ham Node.js'dagi `EventEmitter` ustiga qurilgan va `EventEmitter` ham aynan **function reference** orqali listenerlarni saqlaydi. Shu sababli bu qoida faqat Socket.IO uchun emas, balki Node.js `EventEmitter`, DOM'dagi `addEventListener/removeEventListener` va boshqa event tizimlarida ham bir xil ishlaydi.

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

Reactning builtint Websocket bilan ozroq ishlaganimda socket.io kabi on emit ni custom yozib olgan edim shunga so'radim aloqasi bormikin deb

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Ha, aloqasi bor. Aslida Socket.IO ham xuddi shu prinsipda ishlaydi.

Agar siz WebSocket ustiga o'zingiz `on`/`emit` yozgan bo'lsangiz, ehtimol ichida shunga o'xshash struktura bo'lgan:

```js
const events = {};
```

yoki

```js
const listeners = new Map();
```

`on`:

```js
function on(event, callback) {
    if (!events[event]) {
        events[event] = [];
    }

    events[event].push(callback);
}
```

`emit`:

```js
function emit(event, data) {
    events[event]?.forEach(fn => fn(data));
}
```

`off`:

```js
function off(event, callback) {
    events[event] = events[event].filter(fn => fn !== callback);
}
```

Ko'ryapsizmi, `off` ham `fn !== callback` orqali ishlayapti. Demak unga **xuddi o'sha callback** berilishi shart.

Agar:

```js
on("message", data => {
    console.log(data);
});
```

desangiz, keyin

```js
off("message", data => {
    console.log(data);
});
```

bu ishlamaydi. Chunki ikkinchi arrow function — yangi obyekt.

---

Shuning uchun DOM API ham shunday ishlaydi:

```js
function click() {
    console.log("click");
}

button.addEventListener("click", click);

// ...

button.removeEventListener("click", click);
```

Ammo:

```js
button.addEventListener("click", () => {});

button.removeEventListener("click", () => {});
```

ham ishlamaydi.

---

Shuning uchun siz WebSocket ustiga yozgan custom `on/off` ham, Node.js `EventEmitter` ham, Socket.IO ham, DOM eventlari ham bir xil prinsipga asoslangan. Farqi faqat implementatsiyasida, **callback reference** ishlatish g'oyasi esa hammasida bir xil. Bu sizning o'sha custom yechimingiz bilan bevosita bog'liq tushuncha.

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

demak off eventni off qilish uchun ikkita functionni solishtiradimi hm qiziq 

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Ha, aynan shunday. 😄 Shu joyi JavaScript'dagi muhim tushunchalardan biri.

Ichkarida soddalashtirib aytganda, `off` shunga o'xshash ish qiladi:

```js
const listeners = [
    handleMessage,
    handleLogin,
    handleDisconnect,
];

function off(event, callback) {
    listeners = listeners.filter(fn => fn !== callback);
}
```

Masalan:

```js
function handleMessage(data) {
    console.log(data);
}

socket.on("message", handleMessage);
```

Ichkarida:

```js
listeners = [
    handleMessage
];
```

Keyin:

```js
socket.off("message", handleMessage);
```

`filter` tekshiradi:

```js
handleMessage === handleMessage // true
```

va uni o'chiradi.

---

Lekin:

```js
socket.on("message", () => {
    console.log("hello");
});
```

keyin:

```js
socket.off("message", () => {
    console.log("hello");
});
```

Bu ichkarida quyidagiga teng:

```js
const f1 = () => console.log("hello");
const f2 = () => console.log("hello");

console.log(f1 === f2); // false
```

Kodlari bir xil bo'lsa ham, ular **ikki xil function object**.

---

Buni yana oddiy misolda ko'rish mumkin:

```js
const obj1 = {};
const obj2 = {};

console.log(obj1 === obj2); // false
```

yoki:

```js
const arr1 = [];
const arr2 = [];

console.log(arr1 === arr2); // false
```

Function ham JavaScript'da obyekt hisoblanadi:

```js
const fn1 = () => {};
const fn2 = () => {};

console.log(fn1 === fn2); // false
```

---

Siz aynan shu narsani tushunganingiz yaxshi, chunki bu nafaqat Socket.IO, balki:

- `removeEventListener`
- `EventEmitter.off`
- `Map` kalitlari
- `Set`
- React'dagi `useCallback`

kabi ko'p joylarda uchraydi.

Masalan, React'da `useCallback`ning asosiy maqsadlaridan biri ham kerak bo'lganda **bir xil function reference**ni saqlab qolishdir. Bu tushunchani yaxshi anglab olsangiz, keyinchalik React optimizatsiyalarini ham tushunish ancha osonlashadi.

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

Bunisini bilmagan ekanman

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Bu juda normal. Aslida ko'pchilik JavaScript yozuvchilar ham buni faqat eventlar bilan ishlaganda chuqur tushunib yetadi.

Masalan, quyidagi kod ko'pchilikni hayron qoldiradi:

```js
console.log({} === {});       // false
console.log([] === []);       // false
console.log(() => {} === () => {}); // false
```

Lekin:

```js
const fn = () => {};

console.log(fn === fn); // true
```

Sababi `===` obyektlarning ichidagi qiymatni emas, **xotiradagi manzilini (reference)** solishtiradi.

---

Shu sababli event tizimlari (`Socket.IO`, `EventEmitter`, `addEventListener`) callbackni o'chirish uchun aynan **o'sha reference**ni saqlab qolishingizni talab qiladi.

Masalan:

```js
function handleMessage(data) {
    console.log(data);
}

socket.on("message", handleMessage);

// ...

socket.off("message", handleMessage);
```

Bu ishlaydi.

Ammo:

```js
socket.on("message", data => {
    console.log(data);
});

socket.off("message", data => {
    console.log(data);
});
```

Kodlari bir xil bo'lsa ham ishlamaydi, chunki bu ikki xil function obyekt.

---

Menga yoqqan tomoni shuki, siz shunchaki "shunday yoziladi" deb qabul qilmay, **"nega?"** deb so'radingiz. Aynan shunday savollar JavaScript'ni chuqurroq tushunishga olib keladi. Backend yozayotganingizda ham, React'da ham bu reference tushunchasi juda ko'p joyda uchraydi.

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

aslida jsda referencs typelarni bilaman faqat off nig mantig'ini bilmas edim 

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Ha, farq aynan shunda ekan. 😊 Siz **reference type** tushunchasini bilarkansiz, faqat `off()` ichida undan qanday foydalanilishini bilmagansiz.

Aslida `off()` ning mantig'i juda sodda:

1. `on()` qilganda callbackni ichki ro'yxatga qo'shadi.
2. `emit()` qilganda shu ro'yxatdagi callbacklarni chaqiradi.
3. `off()` qilganda esa ro'yxatdan **shu callbackning o'zini** topib olib tashlaydi.

Masalan:

```js
const listeners = {
  message: []
};

function on(event, callback) {
  listeners[event].push(callback);
}

function off(event, callback) {
  listeners[event] = listeners[event].filter(fn => fn !== callback);
}

function emit(event, data) {
  listeners[event].forEach(fn => fn(data));
}
```

Shuning uchun `off()` ga "xuddi shunday ko'rinadigan" emas, **o'sha callbackning o'zi** kerak bo'ladi.

Qiziq tomoni, Socket.IO'da yana bir qulay metod bor:

```js
socket.off("newMessage");
```

Bu `newMessage` uchun **barcha listenerlarni** o'chiradi. Lekin React'da buni ehtiyotkorlik bilan ishlatish kerak, chunki boshqa komponentlar ham shu eventni tinglayotgan bo'lishi mumkin. Shu sababli cleanup'da odatda aniq callbackni berish tavsiya qilinadi.

Bu savolingiz yaxshi edi, chunki `off()`ning ichki mantig'ini tushunganingizdan keyin `removeEventListener`, `EventEmitter.off` va shunga o'xshash API'lar ham bir xil tamoyilda ishlashini osongina anglaysiz.

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

demak listenersda on va off uchun bir hil function berish kerak on functionni qo'shadi off olib tashlaydi

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Ha, aynan shunday. 👍

Mantig'i juda sodda:

```js
const listeners = {
    newMessage: []
};
```

`on()`:

```js
function handleMessage(data) {
    console.log(data);
}

socket.on("newMessage", handleMessage);
```

Ichkarida:

```js
listeners.newMessage.push(handleMessage);
```

Natija:

```js
listeners.newMessage = [
    handleMessage
];
```

Keyin:

```js
socket.off("newMessage", handleMessage);
```

Ichkarida:

```js
listeners.newMessage =
    listeners.newMessage.filter(fn => fn !== handleMessage);
```

Natija:

```js
listeners.newMessage = [];
```

---

Shuning uchun **`on()` listener qo'shadi**, **`off()` esa o'sha listenerni olib tashlaydi**.

Agar boshqa function bersangiz:

```js
socket.off("newMessage", () => {});
```

Socket ichida:

```js
listeners.newMessage = [
    handleMessage
];
```

u esa qidiryapti:

```js
() => {}
```

Topolmaydi, chunki bunday function ro'yxatda yo'q.

---

Sizning tushunganingizni bitta jumla bilan aytganda:

> **`on()` listenerni ro'yxatga qo'shadi, `off()` esa ro'yxatdan aynan o'sha listenerni reference orqali topib o'chiradi.**

Bu aynan to'g'ri tushuncha. Shu sababli React'dagi `useEffect` cleanup'larida ham doim bitta callbackni o'zgaruvchiga yoki nomlangan funksiyaga saqlab ishlatish tavsiya qilinadi.

---

# User context reducer implementation

### 🤖 Claude:

Bir muammo bor — variable naming conflict:



js
// ❌ ikkalasi ham "event" nomida!
socket.onmessage = (event) => {           // ← WebSocket event
    const { event, data } = JSON.parse(event.data)  // ← destructure event
}



js
// ✅ parameter nomini o'zgartir
socket.onmessage = (msg) => {
    const { event, data } = JSON.parse(msg.data)
    if (listeners[event]) {
        listeners[event](data)
    }
}

To'liq kod:


js
const socket = new WebSocket("ws://localhost:3001")

socket.onopen = () => console.log("Ulandi!")
socket.onclose = () => console.log("Uzildi!")

const listeners = {}

socket.on = (event, cb) => {
    listeners[event] = cb
}

socket.emit = (event, data) => {
    if (socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
        socket.send(JSON.stringify({ event, data }))
    } else {
        console.log("Socket ulanmagan!")
    }
}

socket.onmessage = (msg) => {
    const { event, data } = JSON.parse(msg.data)
    if (listeners[event]) {
        listeners[event](data)
    }
}

export default socket

Sinab ko'r! 🚀

---

### 🤖 Claude:

Yaxshi yondashuv! onopen ichiga qo'yding — endi CONNECTING state xatosi bo'lmaydi. 👍

Lekin bir narsa:



js
// socket.on ni ham onopen ichiga olish kerakmas —
// chunki listenerlarni ulanishdan OLDIN qo'shish kerak bo'ladi

socket.on("connection", (data) => { ... })  // ← bu onopen dan oldin chaqiriladi

Hozirgi kod to'g'ri ishlaydi! Faqat socket.on tashqarida qolsin — bu intentional. ✅

Qisqa xulosa:


onopen  → emit va onmessage faollashadi  ✅
onclose → emit va onmessage o'chiriladi  ✅
on      → har doim tayyor, tashqarida    ✅

Endi App.jsx da ishlatib ko'ramizmi? 🚀

---

### 🤖 Claude:

Kodda bir nechta muammo ko'rinyabdi:

1. client.onmessage emas client.on('message') — ws da:



ts
// ❌
client.onmessage = (event) => {
    const res = JSON.parse(event.data.toString())
}

// ✅
client.on("message", (raw) => {
    const res = JSON.parse(raw.toString())
    const { event, data } = res
})

2. Hardcoded data — haqiqiy data ishlatilmayabdi:



ts
// ❌
const {event : msg, data} = { event: 'newMessage', data: { message: 'fdvfd' } }

// ✅
const { event, data } = JSON.parse(raw.toString())

3. socket.on render da chaqirilayabdi — useEffect ichiga olish kerak:



js
// ❌ — har renderda yangi listener qo'shiladi
socket.on("newMessage", (data) => {
    messagesDispatch({ type: "create", payload: data })
})

// ✅
useEffect(() => {
    socket.on("newMessage", (data) => {
        messagesDispatch({ type: "create", payload: data })
    })
}, [])

To'g'rilangan Gateway:


ts
handleConnection(client: WebSocketHack) {
    client.id = crypto.randomUUID()
    console.log("Connect [" + client.id + "]")
    
    client.send(JSON.stringify({ event: "connection", id: client.id }))

    client.on("message", (raw) => {
        const { event, data } = JSON.parse(raw.toString())
        console.log("Xabar keldi:", event, data)

        // Hammaga yuborish
        this.server.clients.forEach((c) => {
            c.send(JSON.stringify({ event, data }))
        })
    })
}

To'g'rilangan App.jsx:


jsx
useEffect(() => {
    socket.on("connection", (data) => {
        console.log("Mening idm:", data.id)
    })

    socket.on("newMessage", (data) => {
        messagesDispatch({ type: "create", payload: data })
    })
}, [])

Sinab ko'r — xabar hammaga ketayaptimi? 🚀

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

backendda on qo'shganim yo'q uni faqat frontda qo'shdim

### 🤖 Claude:

Ha, to'g'ri! 😄



ts
// ws da backend uchun — client.on("message") built-in
client.on("message", (raw) => {  // ← bu ws ning o'z methodi
    const { event, data } = JSON.parse(raw.toString())
})

// socket.on — biz frontda o'zimiz yozgan custom method
socket.on("newMessage", (data) => {  // ← bu bizning custom method
    messagesDispatch(...)
})

Qisqasi:



Backend  → client.on()  — ws paketi beradi ✅
Frontend → socket.on()  — biz yozdik ✅

Endi xabar hammaga ketayaptimi? 🚀

## Manba: `zdes_archive_docs/raw_history/skills/api-error-handling-patterns.md`

# API Error Handling Patterns

Robust error handling requires coordinated effort between the NestJS backend (throwing consistent exceptions) and the Angular frontend (parsing and displaying them).

## 1. Backend: NestJS Exception Filters

NestJS comes with built-in HTTP exceptions (`NotFoundException`, `BadRequestException`, etc.). To ensure all errors (including unhandled ones) follow a consistent structure, use a global Exception Filter.

```typescript
// src/common/filters/http-exception.filter.ts
import { ExceptionFilter, Catch, ArgumentsHost, HttpException, HttpStatus } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Response } from 'express';

@Catch()
export class AllExceptionsFilter implements ExceptionFilter {
  catch(exception: unknown, host: ArgumentsHost) {
    const ctx = host.switchToHttp();
    const response = ctx.getResponse<Response>();
    const request = ctx.getRequest<Request>();

    let status = HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR;
    let message = 'Internal server error';
    let errors = null;

    if (exception instanceof HttpException) {
      status = exception.getStatus();
      const exceptionResponse: any = exception.getResponse();
      
      // Handle class-validator error arrays
      if (typeof exceptionResponse === 'object' && exceptionResponse.message) {
        message = Array.isArray(exceptionResponse.message) 
          ? exceptionResponse.message[0] // take first validation error, or join them
          : exceptionResponse.message;
        errors = exceptionResponse.message;
      } else {
        message = exception.message;
      }
    } else if (exception instanceof Error) {
       // Log real error internally here (e.g., Prisma errors)
       console.error(exception);
    }

    response.status(status).json({
      statusCode: status,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      path: request.url,
      message,
      errors, // Useful for form field validation highlighting on frontend
    });
  }
}
```

Register it in `main.ts`:
```typescript
app.useGlobalFilters(new AllExceptionsFilter());
```

## 2. Frontend: Angular Error Parsing Strategy

When the backend returns structured errors, the frontend can utilize them for general toasts or specific form field errors.

### General Error Interface

```typescript
// src/app/core/models/api-error.model.ts
export interface ApiErrorResponse {
  statusCode: number;
  timestamp: string;
  path: string;
  message: string;
  errors?: string[] | null;
}
```

### Component-Level Form Error Handling

When submitting a form, you can catch the structured validation errors and map them to UI.

```typescript
// src/app/features/users/create-user.component.ts
import { Component, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { UserService } from '../../core/services/user.service';
import { HttpErrorResponse } from '@angular/common/http';
import { ApiErrorResponse } from '../../core/models/api-error.model';

@Component({ ... })
export class CreateUserComponent {
  fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  userService = inject(UserService);
  
  userForm = this.fb.group({
    email: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.email]],
    password: ['', Validators.required]
  });

  serverErrorMessage = '';

  onSubmit() {
    if (this.userForm.invalid) return;

    this.userService.createUser(this.userForm.value).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        // Handle success (navigate, show toast, etc)
      },
      error: (err: HttpErrorResponse) => {
        const errorData = err.error as ApiErrorResponse;
        this.serverErrorMessage = errorData.message;
        
        // Optional: Map specific validation errors to form controls if needed
        // e.g., if backend returns field-specific errors
      }
    });
  }
}
```
